q.en: In SEO, what is a 'keyword'?
q.hi: SEO mein 'keyword' kya hota hai?
q.mr: SEO मध्ये 'keyword' म्हणजे काय?

en: A word or phrase people type into a search engine
A password used to log in to Google Search Console
A paid tag you buy from Google to rank higher
The HTML code at the top of your homepage
hi: Woh word ya phrase jo log search engine mein type karte hain
Google Search Console login karne ka password
Google se kharida hua paid tag jo ranking badhata hai
Homepage ke top pe likha HTML code
mr: लोक सर्च इंजिनमध्ये टाइप करतात तो शब्द किंवा वाक्यांश
Google Search Console मध्ये login करण्याचा password
ranking वाढवण्यासाठी Google कडून विकत घेतलेला paid tag
homepage च्या वरच्या भागातील HTML code

exp.en: A keyword is the word or phrase users search for, like 'cake shop in Pune'. SEO means making relevant pages for the keywords your customers actually use. You cannot buy organic rankings.
exp.hi: Keyword woh word ya phrase hai jo user search karta hai, jaise 'cake shop in Pune'. SEO ka matlab hai un keywords ke liye relevant pages banana jo aapke customers sach mein use karte hain. Organic ranking kharidi nahi ja sakti.
exp.mr: Keyword म्हणजे user शोधतो तो शब्द किंवा वाक्यांश, उदा. 'cake shop in Pune'. तुमचे ग्राहक खरोखर वापरतात त्या keywords साठी योग्य pages बनवणे म्हणजे SEO. Organic ranking विकत घेता येत नाही.

q.en: What does SERP stand for?
q.hi: SERP ka full form kya hai?
q.mr: SERP चे पूर्ण रूप काय आहे?

en: Search Engine Ranking Program
Search Engine Results Page
Site Engagement Report Panel
Social Engine Reach Percentage
hi: Search Engine Ranking Program
Search Engine Results Page
Site Engagement Report Panel
Social Engine Reach Percentage
mr: Search Engine Ranking Program
Search Engine Results Page
Site Engagement Report Panel
Social Engine Reach Percentage

exp.en: SERP = Search Engine Results Page: the page Google shows after you search, with organic results, ads, maps, videos and other features.
exp.hi: SERP = Search Engine Results Page: search karne ke baad Google jo page dikhata hai, jisme organic results, ads, maps, videos jaise features hote hain.
exp.mr: SERP = Search Engine Results Page: search केल्यानंतर Google दाखवते ते page, ज्यात organic results, ads, maps, videos असे features असतात.

q.en: What is a 'backlink'?
q.hi: 'Backlink' kya hota hai?
q.mr: 'Backlink' म्हणजे काय?

en: A link on your homepage that goes back to the top
The browser's back button on a web page
A link from another website pointing to your website
A broken link that returns an error
hi: Homepage pe ek link jo wapas top pe le jaata hai
Web page pe browser ka back button
Doosri website se aapki website ki taraf aane wala link
Ek broken link jo error deta hai
mr: homepage वरील link जी पुन्हा वर घेऊन जाते
web page वरील browser चे back button
दुसऱ्या website वरून तुमच्या website कडे येणारी link
error देणारी broken link

exp.en: A backlink is a link from another site to yours. Relevant links from trusted sites act like votes of confidence and help Google discover and rank your pages.
exp.hi: Backlink matlab doosri site se aapki site pe aane wala link. Trusted aur relevant sites ke links 'vote of confidence' jaise kaam karte hain aur ranking mein help karte hain.
exp.mr: Backlink म्हणजे दुसऱ्या site वरून तुमच्या site वर येणारी link. विश्वासार्ह आणि relevant sites च्या links 'vote of confidence' सारख्या काम करतात आणि ranking ला मदत करतात.

q.en: Which HTML element usually becomes the blue clickable headline of your page in Google results?
q.hi: Google results mein page ki blue clickable headline aam taur pe kaunse HTML element se aati hai?
q.mr: Google results मध्ये page ची निळी clickable headline सहसा कोणत्या HTML element मधून येते?

en: The <footer> element
The alt attribute
The <body> element
The <title> element
hi: <footer> element
ka alt attribute
<body> element
<title> element
mr: <footer> element
चा alt attribute
<body> element
<title> element

exp.en: The <title> tag is the main source of the title link in search results. Keep it unique, descriptive and not stuffed with keywords.
exp.hi: <title> tag hi search results ki title link ka main source hota hai. Ise unique, descriptive rakho aur keywords se stuff mat karo.
exp.mr: <title> tag हा search results मधील title link चा मुख्य स्रोत असतो. तो unique, वर्णनात्मक ठेवा आणि keywords ने भरू नका.

q.en: Which free Google tool shows how your website performs in Google Search (clicks, queries, indexing issues)?
q.hi: Kaunsa free Google tool dikhata hai ki aapki website Google Search mein kaise perform kar rahi hai (clicks, queries, indexing issues)?
q.mr: तुमची website Google Search मध्ये कशी perform करते (clicks, queries, indexing issues) हे कोणते free Google tool दाखवते?

en: Google Search Console
Google Ads Keyword Planner
Google Forms
Google Keep
hi: Google Search Console
Google Ads Keyword Planner
Google Forms
Google Keep
mr: Google Search Console
Google Ads Keyword Planner
Google Forms
Google Keep

exp.en: Google Search Console is Google's free tool for site owners: search queries, clicks, impressions, indexing status, sitemaps and manual actions. Keyword Planner is for ad keyword research.
exp.hi: Google Search Console site owners ke liye free tool hai: queries, clicks, impressions, indexing status, sitemaps aur manual actions sab yahan dikhte hain. Keyword Planner ads ki keyword research ke liye hai.
exp.mr: Google Search Console हे site owners साठी free tool आहे: queries, clicks, impressions, indexing status, sitemaps आणि manual actions इथे दिसतात. Keyword Planner हे ads च्या keyword research साठी आहे.

q.en: What is image 'alt text' mainly for?
q.hi: Image ka 'alt text' mainly kis liye hota hai?
q.mr: Image चा 'alt text' मुख्यतः कशासाठी असतो?

en: Making the image load faster on slow mobile networks
Describing the image for screen readers and search engines
Adding a watermark so others can't copy the image
Changing the image colours automatically in dark mode
hi: Slow mobile network pe image ko fast load karna
Screen readers aur search engines ke liye image ko describe karna
Watermark lagana taaki koi image copy na kar sake
Dark mode mein image ke colours apne aap badalna
mr: slow mobile network वर image लवकर load करणे
screen readers आणि search engines साठी image चे वर्णन करणे
कोणी image copy करू नये म्हणून watermark लावणे
dark mode मध्ये image चे रंग आपोआप बदलणे

exp.en: Alt text describes an image in words. It helps visually impaired users using screen readers and helps Google understand the image, including for Google Images.
exp.hi: Alt text image ko words mein describe karta hai. Isse screen reader use karne wale users ko help milti hai aur Google ko image samajhne mein bhi, Google Images ke liye bhi.
exp.mr: Alt text image चे शब्दांत वर्णन करतो. Screen reader वापरणाऱ्या users ना आणि Google ला image समजण्यासाठी, Google Images साठीही, याची मदत होते.

q.en: Which statement about Google's organic (non-ad) results is TRUE?
q.hi: Google ke organic (non-ad) results ke baare mein kaunsi baat SACH hai?
q.mr: Google च्या organic (non-ad) results बद्दल कोणते विधान खरे आहे?

en: Running Google Ads automatically improves organic rankings
Organic results are updated only once a year
You cannot pay Google to rank higher in organic results
Only websites with .com domains can rank organically
hi: Google Ads chalane se organic ranking apne aap badh jaati hai
Organic results saal mein sirf ek baar update hote hain
Organic results mein upar aane ke liye Google ko pay nahi kar sakte
Sirf .com domain wali sites hi organic rank kar sakti hain
mr: Google Ads चालवल्याने organic ranking आपोआप वाढते
Organic results वर्षातून फक्त एकदाच update होतात
Organic results मध्ये वर येण्यासाठी Google ला पैसे देता येत नाहीत
फक्त .com domain असलेल्या sites च organic rank करू शकतात

exp.en: Organic rankings are earned through relevance and quality; Google does not sell them. Ads appear separately with a 'Sponsored' label and do not boost organic positions.
exp.hi: Organic ranking relevance aur quality se kamai jaati hai; Google ise bechta nahi. Ads alag se 'Sponsored' label ke saath dikhte hain aur organic position nahi badhate.
exp.mr: Organic ranking relevance आणि quality मुळे मिळते; Google ती विकत नाही. Ads वेगळ्या 'Sponsored' label सह दिसतात आणि organic position वाढवत नाहीत.

q.en: What is 'local SEO'?
q.hi: 'Local SEO' kya hai?
q.mr: 'Local SEO' म्हणजे काय?

en: SEO done only by agencies based in your own city
Hosting your website on a server located in India
Writing all website content in a regional language
Optimizing to show up in nearby searches and Google Maps
hi: Sirf apne shehar ki agencies se SEO karwana
Website ko India mein located server pe host karna
Poori website ka content regional language mein likhna
Nearby searches aur Google Maps mein dikhne ke liye optimize karna
mr: फक्त आपल्या शहरातील agencies कडून SEO करून घेणे
website India मधील server वर host करणे
website चा सर्व content प्रादेशिक भाषेत लिहिणे
जवळच्या searches आणि Google Maps मध्ये दिसण्यासाठी optimize करणे

exp.en: Local SEO helps a business show up for nearby searches like 'dentist near me' or 'saree shop in Nashik', mainly through Google Business Profile, reviews and local pages.
exp.hi: Local SEO se business 'dentist near me' ya 'saree shop in Nashik' jaisi nearby searches mein dikhta hai, mainly Google Business Profile, reviews aur local pages ke through.
exp.mr: Local SEO मुळे business 'dentist near me' किंवा 'saree shop in Nashik' सारख्या जवळच्या searches मध्ये दिसतो, मुख्यतः Google Business Profile, reviews आणि local pages द्वारे.

q.en: Which heading tag is normally used for the main heading of a page?
q.hi: Page ki main heading ke liye normally kaunsa heading tag use hota hai?
q.mr: Page च्या मुख्य heading साठी सहसा कोणता heading tag वापरतात?

en: <head>
<header>
hi: <head>
<header>
mr: <head>
<header>

exp.en: <h1> is the main visible heading that tells users and search engines what the page is about. <head> is the non-visible metadata section, not a heading.
exp.hi: <h1> page ki main visible heading hai jo users aur search engines ko batati hai ki page kis baare mein hai. <head> non-visible metadata section hai, heading nahi.
exp.mr: <h1> ही page ची मुख्य दिसणारी heading असून page कशाबद्दल आहे हे users आणि search engines ना सांगते. <head> हा न दिसणारा metadata विभाग आहे, heading नाही.

q.en: In SEO, what is 'crawling'?
q.hi: SEO mein 'crawling' kya hai?
q.mr: SEO मध्ये 'crawling' म्हणजे काय?

en: Users slowly scrolling down through a very long web page
Bots discovering pages by fetching them and following links
Google sorting indexed pages in order of their quality
Copying text content from competitor websites onto yours
hi: Users ka ek bahut lambe web page ko dheere-dheere scroll karna
Bots ka pages fetch karke aur links follow karke pages dhoondhna
Google ka indexed pages ko quality ke order mein sort karna
Competitor websites se text content copy karke apni site pe daalna
mr: users नी खूप लांब web page हळूहळू scroll करणे
bots नी pages fetch करून आणि links follow करून pages शोधणे
Google ने indexed pages quality नुसार क्रमाने लावणे
competitor websites वरून text content copy करून आपल्या site वर टाकणे

exp.en: Crawling is discovery: bots like Googlebot fetch pages and follow links to find new URLs. After crawling comes indexing, and only indexed pages can rank.
exp.hi: Crawling matlab discovery: Googlebot jaise bots pages fetch karte hain aur links follow karke naye URLs dhoondhte hain. Crawling ke baad indexing hoti hai, aur sirf indexed pages hi rank kar sakte hain.
exp.mr: Crawling म्हणजे शोध: Googlebot सारखे bots pages fetch करतात आणि links follow करून नवीन URLs शोधतात. Crawling नंतर indexing होते, आणि फक्त indexed pages च rank करू शकतात.

q.en: What is an XML sitemap?
q.hi: XML sitemap kya hota hai?
q.mr: XML sitemap म्हणजे काय?

en: A visual map of your office location for Google Maps
A file that blocks bots from crawling your site
A file listing the URLs you want search engines to find
A report that shows your competitors' keywords
hi: Google Maps ke liye office location ka visual map
Ek file jo bots ko site crawl karne se rokti hai
Ek file jisme woh URLs hote hain jo aap search engines ko dikhana chahte ho
Competitors ke keywords dikhane wali report
mr: Google Maps साठी office location चा visual map
bots ना site crawl करण्यापासून रोखणारी file
search engines ना सापडावेत असे URLs असलेली file
competitors चे keywords दाखवणारा report

exp.en: An XML sitemap lists important URLs (often with last-modified dates) to help search engines discover them. It helps discovery but does not guarantee indexing. Blocking bots is robots.txt's job.
exp.hi: XML sitemap mein important URLs (aksar last-modified date ke saath) hote hain taaki search engines unhe dhoondh sakein. Isse discovery mein help milti hai, indexing ki guarantee nahi. Bots rokna robots.txt ka kaam hai.
exp.mr: XML sitemap मध्ये महत्त्वाचे URLs (अनेकदा last-modified तारखेसह) असतात, जेणेकरून search engines ना ते सापडतात. यामुळे discovery ला मदत होते, indexing ची खात्री नाही. Bots रोखणे हे robots.txt चे काम आहे.

q.en: Compared with a short 'head' keyword like 'cake', a long-tail keyword like 'eggless cake delivery Kothrud' usually has…
q.hi: 'cake' jaise chhote 'head' keyword ke comparison mein, 'eggless cake delivery Kothrud' jaise long-tail keyword mein aam taur pe…
q.mr: 'cake' सारख्या छोट्या 'head' keyword च्या तुलनेत, 'eggless cake delivery Kothrud' सारख्या long-tail keyword मध्ये सहसा…

en: Higher search volume and much less competition
No commercial value because few people search it
A higher cost per click in every Google Ads auction
Lower search volume but clearer intent and easier ranking
hi: Zyada search volume aur bahut kam competition
Koi commercial value nahi kyunki kam log search karte hain
Har Google Ads auction mein zyada cost per click
Kam search volume par clear intent aur rank karna aasan
mr: जास्त search volume आणि खूप कमी competition
कमी लोक search करतात म्हणून commercial मूल्य नाही
प्रत्येक Google Ads auction मध्ये जास्त cost per click
कमी search volume पण स्पष्ट intent आणि rank करणे सोपे

exp.en: Long-tail keywords are longer, specific searches. Each gets fewer searches, but the intent is clearer and competition lower, so they are easier to rank for and often convert better.
exp.hi: Long-tail keywords lambe, specific searches hote hain. Har ek ka search volume kam hota hai, par intent clear aur competition kam, isliye rank karna aasan aur conversion aksar better hota hai.
exp.mr: Long-tail keywords म्हणजे लांब, specific searches. प्रत्येकाचा search volume कमी असतो, पण intent स्पष्ट आणि competition कमी, त्यामुळे rank करणे सोपे आणि conversion बहुधा चांगले होते.

q.en: What does it mean when a page is 'indexed' by Google?
q.hi: Jab Google kisi page ko 'index' karta hai toh iska matlab kya hai?
q.mr: Google ने page 'index' केले म्हणजे काय?

en: Google has stored it, so it is eligible to appear in results
The page is guaranteed to rank on the first results page
The page has been added to your Google Ads account
The page has been blocked from appearing in search results
hi: Google ne use store kar liya, ab woh results mein aa sakta hai
Page ka first results page pe rank hona guaranteed hai
Page aapke Google Ads account mein add ho gaya hai
Page search results mein dikhne se block ho gaya hai
mr: Google ने ते साठवले आहे, त्यामुळे ते results मध्ये दिसू शकते
page पहिल्या results page वर rank होणे निश्चित आहे
page तुमच्या Google Ads account मध्ये add झाले आहे
page search results मध्ये दिसण्यापासून block झाले आहे

exp.en: Indexed means Google has processed and stored the page, making it eligible to appear in search. Eligible is not the same as ranking well; that depends on relevance and quality.
exp.hi: Indexed matlab Google ne page process karke store kar liya, ab woh search mein aa sakta hai. Eligible hona aur achha rank karna alag baat hai; ranking relevance aur quality pe depend karti hai.
exp.mr: Indexed म्हणजे Google ने page process करून साठवले, आता ते search मध्ये दिसू शकते. पात्र असणे आणि चांगले rank होणे वेगळे आहे; ranking relevance आणि quality वर अवलंबून असते.

q.en: In local SEO, what does NAP stand for?
q.hi: Local SEO mein NAP ka matlab kya hai?
q.mr: Local SEO मध्ये NAP म्हणजे काय?

en: Network, Audience, Placement
Name, Address, Phone number
New Automated Posting
Nearby Area Promotion
hi: Network, Audience, Placement
Name, Address, Phone number
New Automated Posting
Nearby Area Promotion
mr: Network, Audience, Placement
Name, Address, Phone number
New Automated Posting
Nearby Area Promotion

exp.en: NAP = Name, Address, Phone number. Keeping NAP identical on your website, Google Business Profile and directories helps Google trust your business details.
exp.hi: NAP = Name, Address, Phone number. Website, Google Business Profile aur directories pe NAP same rakhne se Google aapke business details pe trust karta hai.
exp.mr: NAP = Name, Address, Phone number. Website, Google Business Profile आणि directories वर NAP सारखा ठेवल्याने Google ला तुमच्या business माहितीवर विश्वास बसतो.

q.en: What is 'anchor text'?
q.hi: 'Anchor text' kya hota hai?
q.mr: 'Anchor text' म्हणजे काय?

en: The fixed header text that stays on screen while scrolling
The text inside a website's footer
The visible, clickable text of a hyperlink
The hidden text used to describe an image
hi: Scroll karte waqt screen pe fixed rehne wala header text
Website ke footer ka text
Hyperlink ka visible, clickable text
Image describe karne wala hidden text
mr: scroll करताना screen वर स्थिर राहणारा header text
website च्या footer मधील text
hyperlink चा दिसणारा, clickable text
image चे वर्णन करणारा hidden text

exp.en: Anchor text is the clickable text of a link, e.g. 'eggless cakes in Pune'. Descriptive anchors help users and Google understand the linked page. Image descriptions are alt text.
exp.hi: Anchor text link ka clickable text hota hai, jaise 'eggless cakes in Pune'. Descriptive anchor se users aur Google dono ko linked page samajh aata hai. Image description alt text hota hai.
exp.mr: Anchor text म्हणजे link चा clickable text, उदा. 'eggless cakes in Pune'. वर्णनात्मक anchor मुळे users आणि Google दोघांना linked page समजते. Image चे वर्णन म्हणजे alt text.

q.en: Which HTTP status code means 'Page Not Found'?
q.hi: Kaunsa HTTP status code 'Page Not Found' batata hai?
q.mr: कोणता HTTP status code 'Page Not Found' दर्शवतो?

exp.en: 404 means the server could not find the page. 200 means OK, 301 is a permanent redirect and 500 is a server error.
exp.hi: 404 ka matlab server ko page nahi mila. 200 matlab OK, 301 permanent redirect hai aur 500 server error.
exp.mr: 404 म्हणजे server ला page सापडले नाही. 200 म्हणजे OK, 301 म्हणजे permanent redirect आणि 500 म्हणजे server error.

q.en: A page has moved to a new URL forever. Which redirect should you use?
q.hi: Ek page hamesha ke liye naye URL pe shift ho gaya hai. Kaunsa redirect use karna chahiye?
q.mr: एखादे page कायमचे नवीन URL वर गेले आहे. कोणता redirect वापरावा?

en: 301 (permanent)
302 (temporary)
404 (not found)
503 (unavailable)
hi: 301 (permanent)
302 (temporary)
404 (not found)
503 (unavailable)
mr: 301 (permanent)
302 (temporary)
404 (not found)
503 (unavailable)

exp.en: A 301 tells browsers and search engines the move is permanent, so Google shifts indexing and signals to the new URL. A 302 signals a temporary move.
exp.hi: 301 browsers aur search engines ko batata hai ki move permanent hai, isliye Google indexing aur signals naye URL pe shift karta hai. 302 temporary move ka signal hai.
exp.mr: 301 browsers आणि search engines ना सांगतो की बदल कायमचा आहे, त्यामुळे Google indexing आणि signals नवीन URL कडे वळवते. 302 तात्पुरत्या बदलाचा signal आहे.

q.en: What is the search intent behind 'buy running shoes online'?
q.hi: 'buy running shoes online' ke peeche search intent kya hai?
q.mr: 'buy running shoes online' मागचा search intent कोणता आहे?

en: Informational
Transactional
Navigational
Educational
hi: Informational
Transactional
Navigational
Educational
mr: Informational
Transactional
Navigational
Educational

exp.en: The word 'buy' shows the user is ready to purchase, so the intent is transactional. Product and category pages suit it best, not a 'what are running shoes' blog post.
exp.hi: 'buy' word dikhata hai ki user khareedne ko ready hai, isliye intent transactional hai. Iske liye product/category pages best hain, 'running shoes kya hote hain' wala blog nahi.
exp.mr: 'buy' शब्द दाखवतो की user खरेदीसाठी तयार आहे, म्हणून intent transactional आहे. यासाठी product/category pages योग्य, 'running shoes म्हणजे काय' असा blog नाही.

q.en: What does a 'noindex' robots meta tag on a page do?
q.hi: Page pe 'noindex' robots meta tag kya karta hai?
q.mr: Page वरील 'noindex' robots meta tag काय करतो?

en: Stops all users from opening the page in a browser
Makes the page load faster for search engine bots
Asks search engines not to show the page in results
Removes all the links that point to the page
hi: Sabhi users ko browser mein page kholne se rokta hai
Search engine bots ke liye page ko fast load karta hai
Search engines se kehta hai ki page results mein na dikhayein
Page ki taraf aane wale saare links hata deta hai
mr: सर्व users ना browser मध्ये page उघडण्यापासून रोखतो
search engine bots साठी page लवकर load करतो
search engines ना page results मध्ये न दाखवण्यास सांगतो
page कडे येणाऱ्या सर्व links काढून टाकतो

exp.en: noindex keeps a page out of search results, e.g. thank-you or internal search pages. Users can still visit it. Google must be able to crawl the page to see the tag.
exp.hi: noindex page ko search results se bahar rakhta hai, jaise thank-you ya internal search pages. Users phir bhi page khol sakte hain. Tag dekhne ke liye Google ka page crawl kar paana zaroori hai.
exp.mr: noindex page ला search results बाहेर ठेवतो, उदा. thank-you किंवा internal search pages. Users तरीही page उघडू शकतात. Tag दिसण्यासाठी Google ला page crawl करता आले पाहिजे.

q.en: What are 'internal links'?
q.hi: 'Internal links' kya hote hain?
q.mr: 'Internal links' म्हणजे काय?

en: Links shared only inside your company's WhatsApp group
Links from other websites to your homepage
Links that open in a new browser tab
Links from one page of your site to another page on the same site
hi: Sirf company ke WhatsApp group mein share hone wale links
Doosri websites se aapke homepage pe aane wale links
New browser tab mein khulne wale links
Aapki site ke ek page se usi site ke doosre page pe jaane wale links
mr: फक्त कंपनीच्या WhatsApp group मध्ये शेअर होणाऱ्या links
इतर websites वरून तुमच्या homepage वर येणाऱ्या links
नवीन browser tab मध्ये उघडणाऱ्या links
तुमच्या site च्या एका page वरून त्याच site च्या दुसऱ्या page वर जाणाऱ्या links

exp.en: Internal links connect pages on the same site. They help users navigate, help Google discover pages and show which pages are most important. Links from other sites are backlinks.
exp.hi: Internal links same site ke pages ko jodte hain. Isse users ko navigation, Google ko pages discover karne aur important pages samajhne mein help milti hai. Doosri sites ke links backlinks hote hain.
exp.mr: Internal links त्याच site ची pages जोडतात. यामुळे users ना navigation, Google ला pages शोधणे आणि महत्त्वाची pages ओळखणे सोपे होते. इतर sites च्या links म्हणजे backlinks.

q.en: Which URL style is best practice for SEO?
q.hi: SEO ke liye kaunsa URL style best practice hai?
q.mr: SEO साठी कोणती URL style best practice आहे?

en: Short, readable words separated by hyphens
Long numeric IDs like ?id=8372&cat=2
Words joined with underscores and CAPITAL letters
The upload date and time in every URL
hi: Chhote, readable words jo hyphens se alag hon
Lambe numeric IDs jaise ?id=8372&cat=2
Underscores aur CAPITAL letters se jude words
Har URL mein upload date aur time
mr: hyphens ने वेगळे केलेले छोटे, वाचता येणारे शब्द
?id=8372&cat=2 सारखे लांब numeric IDs
underscores आणि CAPITAL letters ने जोडलेले शब्द
प्रत्येक URL मध्ये upload तारीख आणि वेळ

exp.en: Google recommends simple, descriptive URLs with hyphens between words, e.g. /eggless-cakes-pune. They are easier for users to read and share. Google treats hyphens as word separators.
exp.hi: Google simple, descriptive URLs recommend karta hai jisme words ke beech hyphen ho, jaise /eggless-cakes-pune. Users ke liye padhna aur share karna aasan hota hai. Google hyphen ko word separator maanta hai.
exp.mr: Google शब्दांमध्ये hyphen असलेले साधे, वर्णनात्मक URLs सुचवते, उदा. /eggless-cakes-pune. Users ना वाचणे आणि शेअर करणे सोपे जाते. Google hyphen ला शब्द-विभाजक मानते.

q.en: Which of these can a business manage in its Google Business Profile?
q.hi: Business apne Google Business Profile mein inme se kya manage kar sakta hai?
q.mr: Business आपल्या Google Business Profile मध्ये यापैकी काय manage करू शकतो?

en: Its organic ranking position for any keyword
Opening hours, photos and replies to reviews
Deleting any negative review it dislikes
The ads competitors show on Maps
hi: Kisi bhi keyword ke liye apni organic ranking position
Opening hours, photos aur reviews ke replies
Koi bhi negative review jo pasand na ho delete karna
Competitors ke Maps pe dikhne wale ads
mr: कोणत्याही keyword साठी आपली organic ranking position
उघडण्याच्या वेळा, photos आणि reviews ना उत्तरे
न आवडणारा कोणताही negative review delete करणे
competitors चे Maps वरील ads

exp.en: In Google Business Profile you can update hours, photos, services and posts, and reply to reviews. You cannot delete genuine reviews; you can only flag ones that violate Google's policies.
exp.hi: Google Business Profile mein hours, photos, services, posts update kar sakte ho aur reviews ka reply de sakte ho. Genuine reviews delete nahi kar sakte; sirf policy todne wale reviews ko flag kar sakte ho.
exp.mr: Google Business Profile मध्ये वेळा, photos, services, posts update करता येतात आणि reviews ना उत्तर देता येते. खरे reviews delete करता येत नाहीत; फक्त policy मोडणारे reviews flag करता येतात.

q.en: Which HTTP status code tells search engines a page has been permanently removed (gone) with no replacement?
q.hi: Kaunsa HTTP status code search engines ko batata hai ki page permanently hata diya gaya hai (gone) aur koi replacement nahi hai?
q.mr: कोणता HTTP status code search engines ना सांगतो की page कायमचे काढले आहे (gone) आणि पर्याय नाही?

exp.en: 410 Gone says the page was intentionally removed. Both 404 and 410 lead to removal from the index over time; 410 is a slightly stronger signal. 304 means 'not modified'.
exp.hi: 410 Gone batata hai ki page jaan-boojh ke hataya gaya hai. 404 aur 410 dono se page time ke saath index se hat jaata hai; 410 thoda strong signal hai. 304 ka matlab 'not modified'.
exp.mr: 410 Gone सांगतो की page मुद्दाम काढले आहे. 404 आणि 410 दोन्हीमुळे page कालांतराने index मधून जाते; 410 थोडा जास्त स्पष्ट signal आहे. 304 म्हणजे 'not modified'.

q.en: What is 'keyword stuffing'?
q.hi: 'Keyword stuffing' kya hai?
q.mr: 'Keyword stuffing' म्हणजे काय?

en: Researching hundreds of keywords inside one tool
Adding many keywords to your Google Ads account
Grouping related keywords into topic clusters
Unnaturally repeating keywords to manipulate rankings
hi: Ek hi tool mein saikdon keywords research karna
Google Ads account mein bahut saare keywords add karna
Related keywords ko topic clusters mein group karna
Ranking manipulate karne ke liye keywords unnatural tareeke se repeat karna
mr: एकाच tool मध्ये शेकडो keywords शोधणे
Google Ads account मध्ये अनेक keywords add करणे
संबंधित keywords topic clusters मध्ये group करणे
ranking मध्ये फेरफार करण्यासाठी keywords अनैसर्गिकपणे पुन्हा पुन्हा लिहिणे

exp.en: Keyword stuffing, e.g. 'best cake Pune cake Pune cheap cake Pune', is against Google's spam policies and hurts readability. Write naturally for people instead.
exp.hi: Keyword stuffing, jaise 'best cake Pune cake Pune cheap cake Pune', Google ki spam policies ke khilaf hai aur padhne mein bhi kharab lagta hai. Logon ke liye natural likho.
exp.mr: Keyword stuffing, उदा. 'best cake Pune cake Pune cheap cake Pune', हे Google च्या spam policies विरुद्ध आहे आणि वाचायलाही वाईट वाटते. लोकांसाठी नैसर्गिकपणे लिहा.

q.en: Which Google Search Console report shows your queries, clicks, impressions, CTR and average position?
q.hi: Google Search Console ki kaunsi report queries, clicks, impressions, CTR aur average position dikhati hai?
q.mr: Google Search Console मधील कोणता report queries, clicks, impressions, CTR आणि average position दाखवतो?

en: Links report
Performance report
Removals tool
Core Web Vitals report
hi: Links report
Performance report
Removals tool
Core Web Vitals report
mr: Links report
Performance report
Removals tool
Core Web Vitals report

exp.en: The Performance (Search results) report shows which queries and pages bring clicks and impressions, plus CTR and average position. Core Web Vitals covers page experience, not queries.
exp.hi: Performance (Search results) report batati hai kaunsi queries aur pages clicks, impressions laate hain, saath mein CTR aur average position. Core Web Vitals page experience ke liye hai, queries ke liye nahi.
exp.mr: Performance (Search results) report दाखवतो कोणत्या queries आणि pages मुळे clicks, impressions येतात, तसेच CTR आणि average position. Core Web Vitals हा page experience साठी आहे, queries साठी नाही.

q.en: What is structured data (schema markup) used for in SEO?
q.hi: SEO mein structured data (schema markup) kis kaam aata hai?
q.mr: SEO मध्ये structured data (schema markup) कशासाठी वापरतात?

en: Encrypting the website so that hackers cannot read its pages
Compressing images and scripts so that pages load faster
Describing content in a standard format so it may earn rich results
Guaranteeing a top-3 ranking for every marked-up page
hi: Website encrypt karna taaki hackers pages na padh sakein
Images aur scripts compress karna taaki page fast load ho
Content ko standard format mein batana taaki rich results mil sakein
Har marked-up page ki top-3 ranking guarantee karna
mr: hackers ना pages वाचता येऊ नयेत म्हणून website encrypt करणे
page लवकर load व्हावे म्हणून images आणि scripts compress करणे
rich results मिळू शकतील म्हणून content standard format मध्ये सांगणे
प्रत्येक marked-up page ची top-3 ranking निश्चित करणे

exp.en: Structured data (Schema.org vocabulary) tells search engines what things are: a product, price, recipe, event, business. It can make pages eligible for rich results but does not guarantee them or rankings.
exp.hi: Structured data (Schema.org vocabulary) search engines ko batata hai ki cheez kya hai: product, price, recipe, event, business. Isse page rich results ke liye eligible ho sakta hai, par rich result ya ranking ki guarantee nahi.
exp.mr: Structured data (Schema.org vocabulary) search engines ना सांगतो की गोष्ट काय आहे: product, price, recipe, event, business. यामुळे page rich results साठी पात्र होऊ शकते, पण rich result किंवा ranking ची खात्री नाही.

q.en: Which structured data format does Google recommend in its documentation?
q.hi: Google apne documentation mein kaunsa structured data format recommend karta hai?
q.mr: Google आपल्या documentation मध्ये कोणता structured data format सुचवते?

en: CSV
YAML
XML sitemap
JSON-LD
hi: CSV
YAML
XML sitemap
JSON-LD
mr: CSV
YAML
XML sitemap
JSON-LD

exp.en: Google supports JSON-LD, Microdata and RDFa, but recommends JSON-LD because it sits in a separate script block and is easiest to add and maintain. An XML sitemap is not structured data markup.
exp.hi: Google JSON-LD, Microdata aur RDFa support karta hai, par JSON-LD recommend karta hai kyunki woh alag script block mein hota hai aur add/maintain karna sabse aasan hai. XML sitemap structured data markup nahi hai.
exp.mr: Google JSON-LD, Microdata आणि RDFa support करते, पण JSON-LD सुचवते कारण तो वेगळ्या script block मध्ये असतो आणि add/maintain करणे सर्वात सोपे आहे. XML sitemap हे structured data markup नाही.

q.en: A Pune dental clinic's Google Business Profile shows an old phone number, the website shows a new one, and JustDial shows a third. Patients call the wrong number. Best fix?
q.hi: Pune ke ek dental clinic ke Google Business Profile pe purana phone number hai, website pe naya, aur JustDial pe teesra. Patients galat number pe call kar rahe hain. Best fix kya hai?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका dental clinic च्या Google Business Profile वर जुना phone number आहे, website वर नवीन, आणि JustDial वर तिसराच. रुग्ण चुकीच्या नंबरवर call करतात. सर्वोत्तम उपाय कोणता?

en: Make name, address and phone identical on GBP, site and directories
Delete the Google Business Profile and create a fresh one
Update only the website, since Google trusts it the most
Show all three phone numbers on every listing for safety
hi: GBP, website aur directories pe name, address, phone ek jaisa karo
Google Business Profile delete karke naya bana lo
Sirf website update karo, Google usi pe sabse zyada trust karta hai
Safety ke liye har listing pe teeno phone numbers dikhao
mr: GBP, website आणि directories वर name, address, phone एकसारखे करा
Google Business Profile delete करून नवीन तयार करा
फक्त website update करा, Google तिच्यावरच सर्वात जास्त विश्वास ठेवते
खबरदारी म्हणून प्रत्येक listing वर तिन्ही phone numbers दाखवा

exp.en: Consistent NAP across GBP, website and directories builds trust with Google and stops lost calls. Deleting the profile throws away its reviews and history; adding all numbers creates more confusion.
exp.hi: GBP, website aur directories pe consistent NAP se Google ka trust banta hai aur calls miss nahi hote. Profile delete karne se reviews aur history chali jaati hai; saare numbers daalne se confusion aur badhega.
exp.mr: GBP, website आणि directories वर सारखा NAP ठेवल्याने Google चा विश्वास बसतो आणि calls चुकत नाहीत. Profile delete केल्यास reviews आणि history जाते; सगळे नंबर टाकल्याने गोंधळ वाढतो.

q.en: A coaching institute's blog post 'What is the CAT exam?' ranks at position 4 with 20,000 monthly impressions but only 0.8% CTR. What should you try first?
q.hi: Ek coaching institute ka blog 'What is the CAT exam?' position 4 pe rank kar raha hai, 20,000 monthly impressions hain par CTR sirf 0.8% hai. Sabse pehle kya try karna chahiye?
q.mr: एका coaching institute चा blog 'What is the CAT exam?' position 4 वर rank होतो, दरमहा 20,000 impressions आहेत पण CTR फक्त 0.8% आहे. सर्वात आधी काय करून पाहावे?

en: Build 200 new backlinks to the post within this month
Rewrite the title and meta description to better match the query
Delete the post and publish a brand-new one on the topic
Repeat the keyword 'CAT exam' 30 more times in the body
hi: Is mahine post ke liye 200 naye backlinks banao
Title aur meta description ko query se better match karke likho
Post delete karke usi topic pe bilkul naya post daalo
Body mein 'CAT exam' keyword 30 baar aur repeat karo
mr: या महिन्यात post साठी 200 नवीन backlinks तयार करा
title आणि meta description query शी अधिक जुळतील असे लिहा
post delete करून त्याच विषयावर नवीन post टाका
body मध्ये 'CAT exam' keyword आणखी 30 वेळा लिहा

exp.en: Good position plus low CTR usually means the snippet isn't winning clicks. Improving the title and description (e.g. adding the current year's pattern, eligibility, dates) is the fastest test. Stuffing keywords would hurt.
exp.hi: Achhi position aur low CTR ka matlab aksar snippet clicks nahi jeet raha. Title aur description improve karna (jaise pattern, eligibility, dates batana) sabse fast test hai. Keyword stuffing se nuksaan hoga.
exp.mr: चांगली position पण कमी CTR म्हणजे snippet clicks मिळवत नाही. Title आणि description सुधारणे (उदा. pattern, eligibility, dates सांगणे) हा सर्वात जलद प्रयोग आहे. Keyword stuffing ने नुकसान होईल.

q.en: What does adding rel="nofollow" to a link tell Google?
q.hi: Link pe rel="nofollow" lagane se Google ko kya signal milta hai?
q.mr: Link वर rel="nofollow" लावल्याने Google ला काय सांगितले जाते?

en: Never crawl or index the linking page
Open the link in a new tab
You don't want to vouch for or pass ranking credit to the linked page
The linked page is a paid advertisement that must be removed
hi: Linking page ko kabhi crawl ya index mat karo
Link ko new tab mein kholo
Aap linked page ko vouch nahi karna chahte ya ranking credit pass nahi karna chahte
Linked page ek paid ad hai jise hataana zaroori hai
mr: linking page कधीही crawl किंवा index करू नका
link नवीन tab मध्ये उघडा
तुम्ही linked page ची हमी देऊ इच्छित नाही किंवा ranking credit देऊ इच्छित नाही
linked page ही paid ad आहे जी काढावी लागेल

exp.en: nofollow says you don't endorse the linked page. Since 2019 Google treats nofollow, sponsored and ugc as hints. Paid links should use rel=sponsored; user comments can use rel=ugc.
exp.hi: nofollow batata hai ki aap linked page ko endorse nahi karte. 2019 se Google nofollow, sponsored aur ugc ko hints ki tarah treat karta hai. Paid links pe rel=sponsored aur user comments pe rel=ugc use karo.
exp.mr: nofollow सांगतो की तुम्ही linked page ला endorse करत नाही. 2019 पासून Google nofollow, sponsored आणि ugc यांना hints मानते. Paid links साठी rel=sponsored आणि user comments साठी rel=ugc वापरा.

q.en: A D2C tea brand's product page for 'Assam Tea 250g' uses the same manufacturer description that 30 other sellers use. It barely ranks. Best improvement?
q.hi: Ek D2C tea brand ke 'Assam Tea 250g' product page pe wahi manufacturer description hai jo 30 aur sellers use karte hain. Page mushkil se rank karta hai. Best improvement kya hai?
q.mr: एका D2C tea brand च्या 'Assam Tea 250g' product page वर तेच manufacturer description आहे जे आणखी 30 sellers वापरतात. Page क्वचितच rank होते. सर्वोत्तम सुधारणा कोणती?

en: Add a canonical tag that points to the Amazon listing
Hide the copied description text from users using CSS
Copy a competitor's better-written description instead
Write a unique description with origin, brewing tips, photos, reviews
hi: Amazon listing ki taraf point karta canonical tag lagao
Copied description ko CSS se users se chhupa do
Competitor ka better likha hua description copy kar lo
Origin, brewing tips, photos, reviews ke saath unique description likho
mr: Amazon listing कडे निर्देश करणारा canonical tag लावा
copied description CSS ने users पासून लपवा
competitor चे अधिक चांगले लिहिलेले description copy करा
origin, brewing tips, photos, reviews सह unique description लिहा

exp.en: Duplicate manufacturer copy gives Google no reason to prefer your page. Original, helpful details make it distinct. A canonical to Amazon would hand your ranking to Amazon; hidden text is against spam policies.
exp.hi: Duplicate manufacturer copy se Google ke paas aapke page ko prefer karne ki koi wajah nahi. Original, helpful details page ko alag banate hain. Amazon ki taraf canonical se ranking Amazon ko mil jaayegi; hidden text spam policy ke khilaf hai.
exp.mr: Duplicate manufacturer copy मुळे Google ला तुमचे page निवडण्याचे कारणच नसते. मूळ, उपयुक्त माहिती page ला वेगळे बनवते. Amazon कडे canonical लावल्यास ranking Amazon ला जाईल; hidden text spam policy विरुद्ध आहे.

q.en: What is 'keyword cannibalization'?
q.hi: 'Keyword cannibalization' kya hai?
q.mr: 'Keyword cannibalization' म्हणजे काय?

en: Your own pages competing for the same query and intent
A competitor copying your keywords into their ads
Google stripping the keywords out of your meta tags
Using too few keywords across a page's content
hi: Aapke hi pages ka same query aur intent ke liye compete karna
Competitor ka aapke keywords apne ads mein copy karna
Google ka aapke meta tags se keywords hata dena
Page ke content mein bahut kam keywords use karna
mr: तुमच्याच pages ची एकाच query आणि intent साठी स्पर्धा
competitor ने तुमचे keywords आपल्या ads मध्ये copy करणे
Google ने तुमच्या meta tags मधून keywords काढून टाकणे
page च्या content मध्ये खूप कमी keywords वापरणे

exp.en: When multiple pages target the same intent, signals get split and Google may swap between them, so none ranks strongly. The fix is usually to merge, differentiate or re-link the pages.
exp.hi: Jab kai pages same intent target karte hain, signals bat jaate hain aur Google unke beech swap karta rehta hai, isliye koi bhi strong rank nahi karta. Fix: pages merge karo, alag banao ya internal linking theek karo.
exp.mr: अनेक pages एकाच intent ला target करतात तेव्हा signals विभागले जातात आणि Google त्यांच्यात बदल करत राहते, त्यामुळे कोणतेच page मजबूत rank होत नाही. उपाय: pages merge करा, वेगळी करा किंवा internal linking सुधारा.

q.en: Which Core Web Vital measures how quickly the main content of a page loads?
q.hi: Kaunsa Core Web Vital measure karta hai ki page ka main content kitni jaldi load hota hai?
q.mr: Page चा मुख्य content किती लवकर load होतो हे कोणता Core Web Vital मोजतो?

en: CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift)
LCP (Largest Contentful Paint)
INP (Interaction to Next Paint)
TTL (Time To Live)
hi: CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift)
LCP (Largest Contentful Paint)
INP (Interaction to Next Paint)
TTL (Time To Live)
mr: CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift)
LCP (Largest Contentful Paint)
INP (Interaction to Next Paint)
TTL (Time To Live)

exp.en: LCP measures when the largest visible element (often a hero image or heading) finishes rendering. CLS measures visual stability and INP measures responsiveness. TTL is a DNS/cache setting, not a Web Vital.
exp.hi: LCP measure karta hai ki sabse bada visible element (aksar hero image ya heading) kab render hota hai. CLS visual stability aur INP responsiveness measure karta hai. TTL DNS/cache setting hai, Web Vital nahi.
exp.mr: LCP मोजतो की सर्वात मोठा दिसणारा element (बहुधा hero image किंवा heading) कधी render होतो. CLS visual stability आणि INP responsiveness मोजतो. TTL ही DNS/cache setting आहे, Web Vital नाही.

q.en: According to Google, what LCP value counts as 'good'?
q.hi: Google ke hisaab se kaunsi LCP value 'good' maani jaati hai?
q.mr: Google नुसार कोणती LCP value 'good' मानली जाते?

en: Under 10 seconds
Under 5 seconds
2.5 seconds or less
200 milliseconds or less
hi: 10 seconds se kam
5 seconds se kam
2.5 seconds ya usse kam
200 milliseconds ya usse kam
mr: 10 seconds पेक्षा कमी
5 seconds पेक्षा कमी
2.5 seconds किंवा कमी
200 milliseconds किंवा कमी

exp.en: Google's 'good' thresholds: LCP 2.5 s or less, INP 200 ms or less, CLS 0.1 or less, measured at the 75th percentile of real visits. 200 ms is the INP threshold, not LCP.
exp.hi: Google ke 'good' thresholds: LCP 2.5 s ya kam, INP 200 ms ya kam, CLS 0.1 ya kam, real visits ke 75th percentile pe measure. 200 ms INP ka threshold hai, LCP ka nahi.
exp.mr: Google चे 'good' thresholds: LCP 2.5 s किंवा कमी, INP 200 ms किंवा कमी, CLS 0.1 किंवा कमी, खऱ्या visits च्या 75th percentile वर मोजलेले. 200 ms हा INP चा threshold आहे, LCP चा नाही.

q.en: A Mumbai real-estate website is moving from http:// to https://. What is the correct way to do it for SEO?
q.hi: Mumbai ki ek real-estate website http:// se https:// pe shift ho rahi hai. SEO ke liye sahi tareeka kya hai?
q.mr: मुंबईतील एक real-estate website http:// वरून https:// वर जात आहे. SEO साठी योग्य पद्धत कोणती?

en: Keep both versions live with no redirects so no traffic is lost
302-redirect only the homepage and leave other pages unchanged
Block the old http version of every page in robots.txt
301 each http URL to https; update internal links, canonicals, sitemap
hi: Traffic na jaaye isliye dono versions bina redirect ke live rakho
Sirf homepage ko 302 redirect karo, baaki pages waise hi chhodo
Har page ka purana http version robots.txt mein block karo
Har http URL ko https pe 301 karo; internal links, canonicals, sitemap update karo
mr: traffic जाऊ नये म्हणून दोन्ही versions redirect शिवाय live ठेवा
फक्त homepage ला 302 redirect करा, बाकी pages तशीच ठेवा
प्रत्येक page चे जुने http version robots.txt मध्ये block करा
प्रत्येक http URL https कडे 301 करा; internal links, canonicals, sitemap update करा

exp.en: Page-to-page 301 redirects pass signals to the https URLs, and updating internal links, canonicals and the sitemap avoids mixed signals. Blocking http in robots.txt would stop Google from seeing the redirects.
exp.hi: Page-to-page 301 redirects signals ko https URLs tak pahunchate hain, aur internal links, canonicals, sitemap update karne se mixed signals nahi jaate. robots.txt mein http block karne se Google redirects dekh hi nahi paayega.
exp.mr: Page-to-page 301 redirects मुळे signals https URLs कडे जातात, आणि internal links, canonicals, sitemap update केल्याने गोंधळ टळतो. robots.txt मध्ये http block केल्यास Google ला redirects दिसणारच नाहीत.

q.en: You want an old page removed from Google's index. Why is disallowing it in robots.txt NOT the right method?
q.hi: Aap chahte ho ki ek purana page Google ke index se hat jaaye. robots.txt mein disallow karna sahi tareeka kyun NAHI hai?
q.mr: एखादे जुने page Google च्या index मधून काढायचे आहे. robots.txt मध्ये disallow करणे योग्य पद्धत का नाही?

en: Google can't crawl it to see noindex; links can still get it indexed
robots.txt rules only apply to images, not to HTML pages
robots.txt permanently deletes the page from your server
Google penalizes every website that has a robots.txt file
hi: Google crawl karke noindex nahi dekh paata; links se URL phir bhi index ho sakta hai
robots.txt rules sirf images pe lagte hain, HTML pages pe nahi
robots.txt page ko server se permanently delete kar deta hai
Jis website pe robots.txt file ho, Google use penalize karta hai
mr: Google crawl करून noindex पाहू शकत नाही; links मुळे URL तरीही index होऊ शकतो
robots.txt चे नियम फक्त images ना लागू होतात, HTML pages ना नाही
robots.txt page server वरून कायमचे delete करतो
robots.txt file असलेल्या प्रत्येक website ला Google penalize करते

exp.en: robots.txt controls crawling, not indexing. A blocked URL can still appear (without a description) if other pages link to it. Use noindex (and allow crawling), or return 404/410 if the page is gone.
exp.hi: robots.txt crawling control karta hai, indexing nahi. Blocked URL bhi (bina description ke) dikh sakta hai agar doosre pages usse link karein. noindex use karo (crawling allow rakho), ya page hata diya ho toh 404/410 do.
exp.mr: robots.txt crawling नियंत्रित करतो, indexing नाही. Blocked URL इतर pages वरून link असल्यास (description शिवाय) दिसू शकतो. noindex वापरा (crawling allow ठेवा), किंवा page काढले असल्यास 404/410 द्या.

q.en: A Nashik clinic chain has three branches in different areas. How should it set up Google Business Profile?
q.hi: Nashik ki ek clinic chain ke teen alag areas mein branches hain. Google Business Profile kaise set up karna chahiye?
q.mr: नाशिकमधील एका clinic chain च्या तीन वेगवेगळ्या भागात branches आहेत. Google Business Profile कसे set up करावे?

en: One profile for all branches using the head office address
A separate verified profile per branch, each with its own address and phone
Several profiles per branch to cover more keywords in Maps
No profile at all; rely only on the website's contact page
hi: Saari branches ke liye head office address wala ek profile
Har branch ka alag verified profile, apne address aur phone ke saath
Maps mein zyada keywords ke liye har branch ke kai profiles
Koi profile nahi; sirf website ke contact page pe depend karo
mr: सर्व branches साठी head office पत्त्याचा एकच profile
प्रत्येक branch चा स्वतःचा पत्ता आणि phone असलेला वेगळा verified profile
Maps मध्ये जास्त keywords साठी प्रत्येक branch चे अनेक profiles
profile नकोच; फक्त website च्या contact page वर अवलंबून राहा

exp.en: Each real, staffed location can have its own profile, which lets every branch appear in nearby Maps searches. Multiple profiles for one location violate Google's guidelines and can get listings suspended.
exp.hi: Har real, staffed location ka apna profile ho sakta hai, jisse har branch nearby Maps searches mein dikhti hai. Ek location ke multiple profiles Google guidelines ke khilaf hain aur listing suspend ho sakti hai.
exp.mr: प्रत्येक खऱ्या, कर्मचारी असलेल्या location चा स्वतंत्र profile असू शकतो, त्यामुळे प्रत्येक branch जवळच्या Maps searches मध्ये दिसते. एका location चे अनेक profiles Google guidelines विरुद्ध आहेत आणि listing suspend होऊ शकते.

q.en: Google says local search results are mainly based on which three factors?
q.hi: Google ke mutabik local search results mainly kin teen factors pe based hote hain?
q.mr: Google नुसार local search results मुख्यतः कोणत्या तीन घटकांवर आधारित असतात?

en: Domain age, backlinks and ad spend
Photos, posts and website speed
Relevance, distance and prominence
Number of reviews, opening hours and logo
hi: Domain age, backlinks aur ad spend
Photos, posts aur website speed
Relevance, distance aur prominence
Reviews ki sankhya, opening hours aur logo
mr: Domain age, backlinks आणि ad spend
Photos, posts आणि website speed
Relevance, distance आणि prominence
reviews ची संख्या, उघडण्याच्या वेळा आणि logo

exp.en: Google's help docs name relevance (match to the search), distance (from the searcher) and prominence (how well-known, including reviews and links). Ad spend has no effect on local organic rankings.
exp.hi: Google ke help docs teen factors batate hain: relevance (search se match), distance (searcher se doori) aur prominence (kitna jaana-maana, reviews aur links samet). Ad spend se local organic ranking pe koi asar nahi.
exp.mr: Google च्या help docs मध्ये तीन घटक आहेत: relevance (search शी जुळणे), distance (searcher पासूनचे अंतर) आणि prominence (किती प्रसिद्ध, reviews आणि links सह). Ad spend चा local organic ranking वर परिणाम होत नाही.

q.en: A Pune bakery owner is offered '500 high-DA backlinks for ₹2,000' by an online seller. What should you advise?
q.hi: Pune ke ek bakery owner ko online seller '₹2,000 mein 500 high-DA backlinks' offer kar raha hai. Aap kya advice doge?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका bakery मालकाला online seller '₹2,000 मध्ये 500 high-DA backlinks' offer करत आहे. तुम्ही काय सल्ला द्याल?

en: Buy them, because more links always means higher rankings
Buy them now and add rel=sponsored later if rankings drop
Buy only 100 of them so the link profile looks natural
Decline; paid link schemes break Google's spam policies. Earn local links
hi: Khareed lo, kyunki zyada links matlab hamesha zyada ranking
Abhi khareed lo, ranking gire toh baad mein rel=sponsored laga dena
Sirf 100 khareedo taaki link profile natural lage
Mana karo; paid link schemes Google spam policy todte hain. Local links kamao
mr: विकत घ्या, कारण जास्त links म्हणजे नेहमी जास्त ranking
आता विकत घ्या, ranking घसरले तर नंतर rel=sponsored लावा
link profile नैसर्गिक वाटावे म्हणून फक्त 100 घ्या
नकार द्या; paid link schemes Google spam policy मोडतात. Local links मिळवा

exp.en: Cheap bulk links are usually spammy and are link schemes under Google's spam policies. At best Google ignores them; at worst you get a manual action. Real local mentions and partnerships are safer and more useful.
exp.hi: Saste bulk links aksar spammy hote hain aur Google spam policy mein link scheme maane jaate hain. Best case Google unhe ignore karega; worst case manual action. Real local mentions aur partnerships safe aur useful hain.
exp.mr: स्वस्त bulk links बहुधा spammy असतात आणि Google spam policy नुसार link scheme मानल्या जातात. चांगल्यात चांगले Google त्या दुर्लक्षित करेल; वाईटात वाईट manual action मिळेल. खरे local mentions आणि partnerships सुरक्षित आणि उपयुक्त आहेत.

q.en: Which Search Console tool lets you check whether a specific URL is indexed and request indexing after an update?
q.hi: Search Console ka kaunsa tool check karne deta hai ki ek specific URL indexed hai ya nahi, aur update ke baad indexing request karne deta hai?
q.mr: एखादा specific URL indexed आहे का ते तपासणे आणि update नंतर indexing request करणे हे Search Console च्या कोणत्या tool ने करता येते?

en: URL Inspection tool
Disavow tool
Removals tool
Links report
hi: URL Inspection tool
Disavow tool
Removals tool
Links report
mr: URL Inspection tool
Disavow tool
Removals tool
Links report

exp.en: URL Inspection shows a URL's index status, the canonical Google chose, and crawl details, and lets you request indexing. Removals temporarily hides URLs; it doesn't add them.
exp.hi: URL Inspection URL ka index status, Google ka chuna hua canonical aur crawl details dikhata hai, aur indexing request karne deta hai. Removals tool URLs ko temporarily hide karta hai, add nahi karta.
exp.mr: URL Inspection हे URL चा index status, Google ने निवडलेला canonical आणि crawl तपशील दाखवते, आणि indexing request करू देते. Removals tool URLs तात्पुरते लपवते, add करत नाही.

q.en: In hreflang annotations, what is the 'x-default' value used for?
q.hi: hreflang annotations mein 'x-default' value kis liye use hoti hai?
q.mr: hreflang annotations मध्ये 'x-default' value कशासाठी वापरतात?

en: Marks whichever language version gets the most traffic
Fallback page when no listed language or region matches the user
Tells Google to ignore all the other hreflang tags
Sets English as the default language for all Google users
hi: Jis language version pe sabse zyada traffic ho use mark karta hai
Jab koi listed language ya region user se match na kare, tab ka fallback page
Google ko baaki saare hreflang tags ignore karne ko kehta hai
Saare Google users ke liye English ko default language banata hai
mr: सर्वाधिक traffic असलेले language version mark करतो
कोणतीही listed भाषा किंवा region user शी जुळत नसेल तेव्हाचे fallback page
Google ला इतर सर्व hreflang tags दुर्लक्ष करायला सांगतो
सर्व Google users साठी English default भाषा ठरवतो

exp.en: x-default points to the page to show when no listed language/region matches, often a language selector or global page. It doesn't override other hreflang values.
exp.hi: x-default woh page batata hai jo tab dikhe jab koi listed language/region match na kare, aksar language selector ya global page. Yeh baaki hreflang values ko override nahi karta.
exp.mr: x-default ते page दाखवतो जे कोणतीही listed भाषा/region जुळत नसताना दिसावे, बहुधा language selector किंवा global page. हे इतर hreflang values override करत नाही.

q.en: A Bengaluru SaaS startup wants to rank its product page for 'best CRM for small business India'. The top 10 results are all comparison articles. Why is it struggling, and what should it do?
q.hi: Bengaluru ka ek SaaS startup apne product page ko 'best CRM for small business India' ke liye rank karwana chahta hai. Top 10 results saare comparison articles hain. Kyun struggle ho raha hai aur kya karna chahiye?
q.mr: बेंगळुरूमधील एका SaaS startup ला आपले product page 'best CRM for small business India' साठी rank करायचे आहे. Top 10 results सर्व comparison articles आहेत. अडचण का येते आणि काय करावे?

en: Keyword density is too low, so repeat the exact phrase more often
Google penalizes SaaS product pages, so move to a brand-new domain
Intent mismatch: searchers want comparisons, so publish a fair comparison guide
The page has too few images, so add a large screenshot gallery
hi: Keyword density kam hai, isliye exact phrase ko aur repeat karo
Google SaaS product pages ko penalize karta hai, isliye naya domain lo
Intent mismatch: log comparisons chahte hain, toh fair comparison guide banao
Page pe images kam hain, isliye badi screenshot gallery add karo
mr: keyword density कमी आहे, म्हणून exact phrase आणखी वेळा लिहा
Google SaaS product pages ना penalize करते, म्हणून नवीन domain घ्या
Intent mismatch: लोकांना comparisons हवी आहेत, म्हणून fair comparison guide बनवा
page वर images कमी आहेत, म्हणून मोठी screenshot gallery add करा

exp.en: The SERP shows what intent Google sees for a query. 'Best X' queries want comparisons, so a single product page rarely fits. A fair comparison guide matches intent and can still feature the product.
exp.hi: SERP dikhata hai ki Google query ka intent kya samajhta hai. 'Best X' queries mein log comparison chahte hain, isliye single product page fit nahi hota. Fair comparison guide intent match karti hai aur product bhi dikha sakti hai.
exp.mr: SERP दाखवते की Google query चा intent काय समजते. 'Best X' queries मध्ये लोकांना comparison हवे असते, म्हणून एकच product page बसत नाही. प्रामाणिक comparison guide intent जुळवते आणि product ही दाखवू शकते.

q.en: What is a 'soft 404'?
q.hi: 'Soft 404' kya hota hai?
q.mr: 'Soft 404' म्हणजे काय?

en: A 404 page with a friendly design and a search box
A page that loads slowly and times out
A redirect from a deleted page to the homepage that uses a 302
A page that returns 200 OK but shows 'not found' or almost no content
hi: Friendly design aur search box wala 404 page
Ek page jo slow load hokar time out ho jaata hai
Deleted page se homepage pe 302 wala redirect
Ek page jo 200 OK return karta hai par 'not found' ya lagbhag khaali content dikhata hai
mr: friendly design आणि search box असलेले 404 page
हळू load होऊन time out होणारे page
deleted page वरून homepage कडे 302 redirect
200 OK देणारे पण 'not found' किंवा जवळजवळ रिकामा content दाखवणारे page

exp.en: A soft 404 tells the server 'OK' while the page is really empty or missing, which confuses search engines and wastes crawling. Return a real 404/410, or add real content. Redirecting many deleted pages to the homepage is also often treated as soft 404.
exp.hi: Soft 404 mein server 'OK' bolta hai jabki page asal mein khaali ya missing hai, jisse search engines confuse hote hain aur crawling waste hoti hai. Asli 404/410 do ya real content daalo. Bahut saare deleted pages ko homepage pe redirect karna bhi aksar soft 404 maana jaata hai.
exp.mr: Soft 404 मध्ये server 'OK' म्हणतो पण page प्रत्यक्षात रिकामे किंवा नसते, त्यामुळे search engines गोंधळतात आणि crawling वाया जाते. खरा 404/410 द्या किंवा खरा content टाका. अनेक deleted pages homepage कडे redirect करणेही बहुधा soft 404 मानले जाते.

q.en: After a website redesign, every URL changed (e.g. /products/saree-123 became /shop/silk-saree). Organic traffic fell 50% within two weeks. Most likely cause and fix?
q.hi: Website redesign ke baad har URL badal gaya (jaise /products/saree-123 ab /shop/silk-saree). Do hafte mein organic traffic 50% gir gaya. Sabse likely cause aur fix?
q.mr: Website redesign नंतर प्रत्येक URL बदलला (उदा. /products/saree-123 आता /shop/silk-saree). दोन आठवड्यांत organic traffic 50% घसरले. सर्वात संभाव्य कारण आणि उपाय?

en: Old URLs weren't 301-redirected; map each to its closest new page
Google is penalizing the new design colours, so revert them
The XML sitemap is too large, so delete it completely
New URLs must be at least 100 characters long to rank
hi: Purane URLs ka 301 redirect nahi hua; har ek ko closest naye page pe map karo
Google naye design ke colours ko penalize kar raha hai, unhe wapas badlo
XML sitemap bahut bada hai, use poori tarah delete kar do
Rank karne ke liye naye URLs kam se kam 100 characters ke hone chahiye
mr: जुन्या URLs ना 301 redirect केले नाही; प्रत्येक जवळच्या नवीन page कडे map करा
Google नव्या design च्या रंगांना penalize करत आहे, ते परत बदला
XML sitemap खूप मोठा आहे, तो पूर्णपणे delete करा
rank होण्यासाठी नवीन URLs किमान 100 characters चे हवेत

exp.en: Without redirects, old ranking URLs become 404s and their links and signals are lost. A one-to-one 301 redirect map from old to new URLs is the core of any migration.
exp.hi: Redirects ke bina purane ranking URLs 404 ban jaate hain aur unke links aur signals kho jaate hain. Purane se naye URLs ka one-to-one 301 redirect map har migration ka core hai.
exp.mr: Redirects शिवाय जुने ranking URLs 404 होतात आणि त्यांच्या links व signals हरवतात. जुन्या ते नवीन URLs चा one-to-one 301 redirect map हा प्रत्येक migration चा गाभा आहे.

q.en: What is the key difference between a canonical tag and a 301 redirect?
q.hi: Canonical tag aur 301 redirect mein main difference kya hai?
q.mr: Canonical tag आणि 301 redirect मधील मुख्य फरक काय आहे?

en: Canonical deletes the duplicate page, while a 301 keeps both indexed
Canonical is a hint and the page stays reachable; a 301 moves users and bots
Canonical works only on mobile, while a 301 works only on desktop
There is no real difference; both send exactly the same signal
hi: Canonical duplicate page delete karta hai, jabki 301 dono ko index rakhta hai
Canonical hint hai aur page khulta rehta hai; 301 users aur bots ko shift karta hai
Canonical sirf mobile pe kaam karta hai, jabki 301 sirf desktop pe
Koi asli fark nahi; dono bilkul same signal bhejte hain
mr: Canonical duplicate page delete करतो, तर 301 दोन्ही index ठेवतो
Canonical हा hint असून page उघडता येते; 301 users आणि bots ना हलवतो
Canonical फक्त mobile वर काम करतो, तर 301 फक्त desktop वर
खरा फरक नाही; दोन्ही अगदी सारखाच signal पाठवतात

exp.en: Use canonical when duplicate versions must stay accessible (e.g. tracking or filter URLs); Google may still choose another canonical. Use a 301 when the old URL should no longer be visited at all.
exp.hi: Canonical tab use karo jab duplicate versions accessible rehne chahiye (jaise tracking ya filter URLs); Google phir bhi doosra canonical chun sakta hai. 301 tab use karo jab purana URL bilkul visit nahi hona chahiye.
exp.mr: Duplicate versions उपलब्ध राहणे गरजेचे असेल (उदा. tracking किंवा filter URLs) तेव्हा canonical वापरा; Google तरीही दुसरा canonical निवडू शकते. जुना URL अजिबात उघडू नये तेव्हा 301 वापरा.

q.en: A D2C brand's React single-page site shows product text only after client-side JavaScript runs, and many product pages are slow to get indexed. What reduces the SEO risk most?
q.hi: Ek D2C brand ki React single-page site pe product text sirf client-side JavaScript chalne ke baad dikhta hai, aur kai product pages index hone mein late hote hain. SEO risk sabse zyada kya kam karega?
q.mr: एका D2C brand च्या React single-page site वर product text फक्त client-side JavaScript चालल्यानंतर दिसतो, आणि अनेक product pages index व्हायला उशीर होतो. SEO risk सर्वात जास्त काय कमी करेल?

en: Block the JavaScript files in robots.txt to speed up crawling
Move all product descriptions inside images to protect them
Server-side render or pre-render so content and links are in the HTML
Just add more product URLs to the XML sitemap and wait
hi: Crawling fast karne ke liye JavaScript files robots.txt mein block karo
Saare product descriptions images ke andar daal do
Server-side render ya pre-render karo taaki content aur links HTML mein hon
Bas XML sitemap mein aur product URLs daal ke wait karo
mr: crawling जलद करण्यासाठी JavaScript files robots.txt मध्ये block करा
सर्व product descriptions images मध्ये टाका
content आणि links HTML मध्ये असावेत म्हणून server-side render किंवा pre-render करा
फक्त XML sitemap मध्ये आणखी product URLs टाकून वाट पाहा

exp.en: Google can render JavaScript, but rendering can be delayed and fails if resources are blocked. SSR/SSG puts content and crawlable <a href> links in the HTML immediately. Blocking JS files would make rendering worse.
exp.hi: Google JavaScript render kar sakta hai, par rendering delay ho sakti hai aur resources block hon toh fail hoti hai. SSR/SSG content aur crawlable <a href> links turant HTML mein de deta hai. JS files block karne se rendering aur kharab hogi.
exp.mr: Google JavaScript render करू शकते, पण rendering ला उशीर होऊ शकतो आणि resources block असल्यास ते अयशस्वी होते. SSR/SSG मुळे content आणि crawlable <a href> links लगेच HTML मध्ये मिळतात. JS files block केल्यास rendering आणखी बिघडेल.

q.en: A Pune travel blog notices Google shows a different headline in search results than its title tag, which reads 'Best Trek | Treks | Pune Treks | Monsoon Treks 2025 | Sahyadri'. Why, and what fixes it?
q.hi: Pune ke ek travel blog ne dekha ki Google search results mein title tag se alag headline dikhata hai. Title tag hai 'Best Trek | Treks | Pune Treks | Monsoon Treks 2025 | Sahyadri'. Kyun, aur fix kya hai?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका travel blog ला दिसले की Google search results मध्ये title tag पेक्षा वेगळी headline दाखवते. Title tag आहे 'Best Trek | Treks | Pune Treks | Monsoon Treks 2025 | Sahyadri'. का, आणि उपाय काय?

en: Google shows ad headlines for blogs, so start running Google Ads
Titles must be written fully in capital letters to be used
The site has a manual action, so file a reconsideration request
Google may rewrite stuffed titles; write one concise, accurate title
hi: Google blogs ke liye ad headlines dikhata hai, toh Google Ads chalao
Title use hone ke liye poora capital letters mein hona chahiye
Site pe manual action hai, isliye reconsideration request bhejo
Google stuffed titles rewrite kar sakta hai; ek concise, accurate title likho
mr: Google blogs साठी ad headlines दाखवते, म्हणून Google Ads चालवा
title वापरला जाण्यासाठी तो पूर्ण capital letters मध्ये हवा
site वर manual action आहे, म्हणून reconsideration request पाठवा
Google stuffed titles rewrite करू शकते; एक छोटा, अचूक title लिहा

exp.en: Google generates title links from several sources and may replace titles that are too long, repetitive or keyword-stuffed. A clear title like 'Monsoon Treks Near Pune: 12 Routes for Beginners' is more likely to be used.
exp.hi: Google title links kai sources se banata hai aur bahut lambe, repetitive ya keyword-stuffed titles ko replace kar sakta hai. 'Monsoon Treks Near Pune: 12 Routes for Beginners' jaisa clear title use hone ke chances zyada hain.
exp.mr: Google अनेक स्रोतांमधून title links तयार करते आणि खूप लांब, पुनरावृत्तीचे किंवा keyword-stuffed titles बदलू शकते. 'Monsoon Treks Near Pune: 12 Routes for Beginners' सारखा स्पष्ट title वापरला जाण्याची शक्यता जास्त असते.

q.en: An online fashion store's filter URLs (?color=red&size=m&sort=price) create lakhs of near-duplicate URLs, and Googlebot spends most of its crawling on them. Best approach?
q.hi: Ek online fashion store ke filter URLs (?color=red&size=m&sort=price) lakhon near-duplicate URLs bana rahe hain, aur Googlebot ki zyada crawling unhi pe ho rahi hai. Best approach?
q.mr: एका online fashion store चे filter URLs (?color=red&size=m&sort=price) लाखो near-duplicate URLs तयार करतात, आणि Googlebot चे बहुतेक crawling त्यावरच जाते. सर्वोत्तम पद्धत कोणती?

en: Keep useful filter pages indexable; block low-value combos like sort URLs
Add a noindex tag to every single category page on the site
Submit every possible filter combination in the XML sitemap
Redirect every filter URL on the site to the homepage
hi: Useful filter pages indexable rakho; sort jaise low-value combos block karo
Site ke har ek category page pe noindex tag laga do
Har possible filter combination XML sitemap mein submit karo
Site ke har filter URL ko homepage pe redirect kar do
mr: उपयुक्त filter pages indexable ठेवा; sort सारखे कमी-मूल्याचे combos block करा
site च्या प्रत्येक category page वर noindex tag लावा
प्रत्येक शक्य filter combination XML sitemap मध्ये submit करा
site चा प्रत्येक filter URL homepage कडे redirect करा

exp.en: Faceted navigation is a classic crawl-waste problem. Decide which filters have real search demand (e.g. 'red kurtis') and keep those; block or de-link endless low-value combinations. Noindexing all categories or redirecting to home would destroy useful pages.
exp.hi: Faceted navigation classic crawl-waste problem hai. Decide karo kaunse filters ki real search demand hai (jaise 'red kurtis') aur unhe rakho; endless low-value combinations ko block ya de-link karo. Saari categories noindex karna ya home pe redirect karna useful pages khatam kar dega.
exp.mr: Faceted navigation ही crawl-waste ची नेहमीची समस्या आहे. कोणत्या filters ना खरी search demand आहे (उदा. 'red kurtis') ते ठरवा आणि ती ठेवा; अंतहीन कमी-मूल्याचे combinations block किंवा de-link करा. सर्व categories noindex करणे किंवा home कडे redirect करणे उपयुक्त pages नष्ट करेल.

q.en: In August 2023 Google limited FAQ rich results in Search. Which sites did it say would still normally be eligible?
q.hi: August 2023 mein Google ne Search mein FAQ rich results limit kar diye. Google ke mutabik ab aam taur pe kaunsi sites eligible rahengi?
q.mr: August 2023 मध्ये Google ने Search मधील FAQ rich results मर्यादित केले. Google नुसार आता सहसा कोणत्या sites पात्र राहतील?

en: Any website that has more than 1,000 backlinks
Well-known, authoritative government and health websites
Only e-commerce sites with product review pages
Websites that are also running Google Ads campaigns
hi: 1,000 se zyada backlinks wali koi bhi website
Well-known, authoritative government aur health websites
Sirf product review pages wali e-commerce sites
Woh websites jo Google Ads campaigns bhi chala rahi hain
mr: 1,000 पेक्षा जास्त backlinks असलेली कोणतीही website
प्रसिद्ध, अधिकृत government आणि health websites
फक्त product review pages असलेल्या e-commerce sites
ज्या websites Google Ads campaigns ही चालवतात

exp.en: In August 2023 Google said FAQ rich results would be shown only for well-known, authoritative government and health sites, and it reduced HowTo rich results. Adding FAQ schema no longer earns FAQ snippets for most business sites.
exp.hi: August 2023 mein Google ne kaha ki FAQ rich results sirf well-known, authoritative government aur health sites ke liye dikhenge, aur HowTo rich results bhi kam kiye. Ab zyada tar business sites ko FAQ schema se FAQ snippets nahi milte.
exp.mr: August 2023 मध्ये Google ने सांगितले की FAQ rich results फक्त प्रसिद्ध, अधिकृत government आणि health sites साठीच दिसतील, आणि HowTo rich results ही कमी केले. आता बहुतेक business sites ना FAQ schema मुळे FAQ snippets मिळत नाहीत.

q.en: A Pune coaching institute has two pages, 'MPSC Coaching in Pune' and 'Best MPSC Classes Pune', with near-identical content. Google keeps swapping them between positions 15 and 25. Best move?
q.hi: Pune ke ek coaching institute ke do pages hain, 'MPSC Coaching in Pune' aur 'Best MPSC Classes Pune', dono ka content lagbhag same. Google dono ko position 15 se 25 ke beech swap karta rehta hai. Best move?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका coaching institute ची दोन pages आहेत, 'MPSC Coaching in Pune' आणि 'Best MPSC Classes Pune', दोन्हींचा content जवळजवळ सारखा. Google दोन्ही pages position 15 ते 25 दरम्यान बदलत राहते. सर्वोत्तम पाऊल कोणते?

en: Create a third page targeting the same MPSC keyword
Add a noindex tag to both pages until rankings settle
Merge into one stronger page and 301 the weaker URL to it
Change the publish date on both pages every single week
hi: Same MPSC keyword ke liye teesra page bana do
Ranking settle hone tak dono pages pe noindex tag laga do
Merge karke ek strong page banao aur weak URL ko us pe 301 karo
Dono pages ki publish date har hafte badalte raho
mr: त्याच MPSC keyword साठी तिसरे page तयार करा
ranking स्थिर होईपर्यंत दोन्ही pages वर noindex tag लावा
merge करून एक मजबूत page बनवा आणि कमकुवत URL त्याकडे 301 करा
दोन्ही pages ची publish date दर आठवड्याला बदलत राहा

exp.en: This is keyword cannibalization. Merging combines the best content and the link signals of both pages into one URL. A third page makes it worse; noindexing both removes you from results.
exp.hi: Yeh keyword cannibalization hai. Merge karne se dono pages ka best content aur link signals ek URL mein aa jaate hain. Teesra page problem badhayega; dono pe noindex se aap results se hi bahar ho jaoge.
exp.mr: हे keyword cannibalization आहे. Merge केल्याने दोन्ही pages चा सर्वोत्तम content आणि link signals एकाच URL मध्ये येतात. तिसरे page समस्या वाढवेल; दोन्हींवर noindex लावल्यास तुम्ही results मधूनच बाहेर पडाल.

q.en: In Search Console, many blog posts show 'Crawled – currently not indexed'. What does this usually mean?
q.hi: Search Console mein kai blog posts 'Crawled – currently not indexed' dikha rahe hain. Iska aam taur pe matlab kya hai?
q.mr: Search Console मध्ये अनेक blog posts 'Crawled – currently not indexed' दाखवतात. याचा सहसा अर्थ काय?

en: The site has received a manual penalty for spammy content
robots.txt is blocking Googlebot from these blog pages
The server returned a 500 error every time Google visited
Google crawled them but chose not to index them, often for low value
hi: Site ko spammy content ke liye manual penalty mili hai
robots.txt Googlebot ko in blog pages se block kar raha hai
Google ke har visit pe server ne 500 error diya
Google ne crawl kiya par index nahi kiya, aksar low value ki wajah se
mr: site ला spammy content साठी manual penalty मिळाली आहे
robots.txt Googlebot ला या blog pages पासून block करत आहे
Google च्या प्रत्येक भेटीत server ने 500 error दिला
Google ने crawl केले पण index केले नाही, बहुधा कमी मूल्यामुळे

exp.en: This status means crawling worked but Google decided the page isn't worth indexing right now. Improve uniqueness and usefulness, consolidate thin or overlapping posts, and add internal links to the important ones.
exp.hi: Is status ka matlab crawling ho gayi par Google ne abhi page ko index karne layak nahi samjha. Uniqueness aur usefulness badhao, thin ya overlapping posts ko merge karo, aur important posts ko internal links do.
exp.mr: या status चा अर्थ crawling झाले पण Google ला सध्या page index करण्याजोगे वाटले नाही. Uniqueness आणि उपयुक्तता वाढवा, thin किंवा overlapping posts merge करा, आणि महत्त्वाच्या posts ना internal links द्या.

q.en: A D2C brand finds a manual action for 'Unnatural links to your site' in Search Console, caused by links an old agency bought. What is the right sequence?
q.hi: Ek D2C brand ko Search Console mein 'Unnatural links to your site' ka manual action mila, jo purani agency ke khareede links ki wajah se hai. Sahi sequence kya hai?
q.mr: एका D2C brand ला Search Console मध्ये 'Unnatural links to your site' चा manual action दिसला, जुन्या agency ने विकत घेतलेल्या links मुळे. योग्य क्रम कोणता?

en: Remove bad links, disavow the rest, then request reconsideration
Move to a new domain immediately and skip all redirects
Buy more high-quality links to outweigh the bad ones
Just wait, because manual actions always expire in 7 days
hi: Bad links hatwao, baaki disavow karo, phir reconsideration request bhejo
Turant naye domain pe jao aur koi redirect mat lagao
Bad links ko balance karne ke liye aur quality links khareedo
Bas wait karo, manual actions hamesha 7 din mein expire hote hain
mr: bad links काढा, उरलेल्या disavow करा, मग reconsideration request पाठवा
लगेच नवीन domain वर जा आणि कोणतेही redirect लावू नका
bad links चा परिणाम कमी करण्यासाठी आणखी quality links विकत घ्या
फक्त थांबा, manual actions नेहमी 7 दिवसांत संपतात

exp.en: A manual action needs a real clean-up: contact sites to remove links, disavow what you can't remove, and explain your efforts in a reconsideration request. Buying more links repeats the violation.
exp.hi: Manual action ke liye real clean-up chahiye: sites se links hatwane ko kaho, jo na hatein unhe disavow karo, aur reconsideration request mein apni efforts explain karo. Aur links khareedna wahi galti dohrana hai.
exp.mr: Manual action साठी खरी साफसफाई लागते: sites ना links काढायला सांगा, न निघणाऱ्या disavow करा, आणि reconsideration request मध्ये प्रयत्न स्पष्ट करा. आणखी links विकत घेणे म्हणजे तीच चूक पुन्हा.

q.en: Your /en-in/ page lists hreflang to /en-gb/, but the /en-gb/ page has no hreflang pointing back. What happens?
q.hi: Aapke /en-in/ page pe /en-gb/ ka hreflang hai, par /en-gb/ page pe wapas point karne wala hreflang nahi hai. Kya hoga?
q.mr: तुमच्या /en-in/ page वर /en-gb/ चा hreflang आहे, पण /en-gb/ page वर परत निर्देश करणारा hreflang नाही. काय होईल?

en: Google automatically adds the missing return tag for you
The pair may be ignored, since hreflang needs return links
Both pages receive a manual action for bad markup
The /en-gb/ page is removed from Google's index
hi: Google missing return tag aapke liye khud add kar deta hai
Pair ignore ho sakta hai, kyunki hreflang ko return links chahiye
Galat markup ke liye dono pages pe manual action lagta hai
/en-gb/ page Google ke index se hata diya jaata hai
mr: Google गहाळ return tag तुमच्यासाठी आपोआप add करते
जोडी दुर्लक्षित होऊ शकते, कारण hreflang ला return links लागतात
चुकीच्या markup साठी दोन्ही pages वर manual action लागतो
/en-gb/ page Google च्या index मधून काढले जाते

exp.en: hreflang needs return links: if page A points to B, B must point back to A (and each page should list itself). Missing return tags make Google ignore the pair. It is not a penalty.
exp.hi: hreflang ko return links chahiye: agar page A, B ko point karta hai toh B ko bhi A ko point karna hoga (aur har page khud ko bhi list kare). Return tag na ho toh Google pair ignore karta hai. Yeh penalty nahi hai.
exp.mr: hreflang ला return links लागतात: page A जर B कडे निर्देश करत असेल तर B ने ही A कडे करायला हवे (आणि प्रत्येक page ने स्वतःलाही list करावे). Return tag नसल्यास Google जोडी दुर्लक्षित करते. ही penalty नाही.

q.en: A Pune restaurant owner wants to give a 10% discount to customers who post a 5-star Google review. What do you advise?
q.hi: Pune ke ek restaurant owner 5-star Google review dene wale customers ko 10% discount dena chahte hain. Aap kya advice doge?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका restaurant मालकाला 5-star Google review देणाऱ्या ग्राहकांना 10% discount द्यायचा आहे. तुम्ही काय सल्ला द्याल?

en: Go ahead, but offer the discount only on weekday evenings
Offer it for any review, positive or negative, to keep it fair
Don't; Google bans incentivized reviews. Ask all customers for honest ones
Ask staff and relatives to post five-star reviews instead
hi: Theek hai, par discount sirf weekday evenings pe do
Koi bhi review ho, positive ya negative, sabko do taaki fair rahe
Mat karo; Google incentivized reviews ban karta hai. Sabse honest review maango
Iske bajaye staff aur rishtedaaron se five-star reviews likhwao
mr: ठीक आहे, पण discount फक्त weekday संध्याकाळी द्या
positive असो वा negative, प्रत्येक review ला द्या म्हणजे न्याय्य राहील
करू नका; Google incentivized reviews वर बंदी घालते. सर्वांकडे प्रामाणिक review मागा
त्याऐवजी staff आणि नातेवाईकांकडून five-star reviews टाकून घ्या

exp.en: Google's review policies forbid offering money, discounts or gifts for reviews, and reviews from staff or relatives count as conflicts of interest. Violations can lead to removed reviews or profile restrictions.
exp.hi: Google ki review policies reviews ke badle paise, discount ya gifts dene ko mana karti hain, aur staff ya rishtedaaron ke reviews conflict of interest maane jaate hain. Violation pe reviews hat sakte hain ya profile pe restriction lag sakta hai.
exp.mr: Google च्या review policies नुसार reviews साठी पैसे, discount किंवा gifts देणे निषिद्ध आहे, आणि staff किंवा नातेवाईकांचे reviews हितसंबंधांचा संघर्ष मानले जातात. उल्लंघन केल्यास reviews काढले जाऊ शकतात किंवा profile वर निर्बंध येऊ शकतात.

q.en: Google's 'site reputation abuse' spam policy (announced 2024) targets which practice?
q.hi: Google ki 'site reputation abuse' spam policy (2024 mein announce hui) kis practice ko target karti hai?
q.mr: Google ची 'site reputation abuse' spam policy (2024 मध्ये जाहीर) कोणत्या प्रथेला लक्ष्य करते?

en: Brands replying rudely or aggressively to negative reviews
Competitors posting fake one-star reviews on your listing
Buying expired domains to host a brand-new business site
Hosting third-party pages on a trusted site to exploit its ranking
hi: Brands ka negative reviews ka rude ya aggressive reply dena
Competitors ka aapki listing pe fake one-star reviews daalna
Naya business site chalane ke liye expired domains khareedna
Trusted site pe third-party pages host karke uski ranking ka fayda uthana
mr: brands नी negative reviews ना उद्धट किंवा आक्रमक उत्तर देणे
competitors नी तुमच्या listing वर खोटे one-star reviews टाकणे
नवीन business site साठी expired domains विकत घेणे
विश्वासार्ह site वर third-party pages host करून तिच्या ranking चा फायदा घेणे

exp.en: Site reputation abuse (sometimes called 'parasite SEO') is when a trusted site hosts third-party content, like coupon or payday-loan pages, mainly to borrow its ranking strength. Expired-domain abuse is a separate policy.
exp.hi: Site reputation abuse (jise 'parasite SEO' bhi kehte hain) tab hota hai jab trusted site third-party content, jaise coupon ya payday-loan pages, mainly uski ranking strength udhaar lene ke liye host karti hai. Expired-domain abuse alag policy hai.
exp.mr: Site reputation abuse (ज्याला 'parasite SEO' ही म्हणतात) म्हणजे विश्वासार्ह site ने third-party content, जसे coupon किंवा payday-loan pages, मुख्यतः तिची ranking ताकद उसनी घेण्यासाठी host करणे. Expired-domain abuse ही वेगळी policy आहे.

q.en: Under Google's 'scaled content abuse' policy (2024), what makes mass-produced content a violation?
q.hi: Google ki 'scaled content abuse' policy (2024) ke hisaab se mass-produced content kab violation banta hai?
q.mr: Google च्या 'scaled content abuse' policy (2024) नुसार mass-produced content केव्हा उल्लंघन ठरते?
