en: Mass pages made mainly to rank with little value, by AI or humans
Any content that was written with the help of an AI tool
Publishing more than 100 new pages on a single day
Using one shared template to build all product pages on a site
hi: Mainly rank karne ke liye bane low-value mass pages, AI ya insaan kisi ne bhi banaye
Koi bhi content jo AI tool ki madad se likha gaya ho
Ek hi din mein 100 se zyada naye pages publish karna
Site ke saare product pages ek shared template se banana
mr: मुख्यतः rank होण्यासाठी बनवलेली कमी-मूल्याची mass pages, AI किंवा माणसांनी
AI tool च्या मदतीने लिहिलेला कोणताही content
एकाच दिवसात 100 पेक्षा जास्त नवीन pages प्रकाशित करणे
site ची सर्व product pages एकाच shared template ने बनवणे

exp.en: Google judges purpose and value, not the tool. Scaled content abuse covers mass pages created mainly to rank, however they're made. Helpful AI-assisted content is allowed; templates are fine if pages add real value.
exp.hi: Google purpose aur value dekhta hai, tool nahi. Scaled content abuse mein woh mass pages aate hain jo mainly rank karne ke liye bane hain, chahe kaise bhi bane hon. Helpful AI-assisted content allowed hai; templates bhi theek hain agar pages real value dein.
exp.mr: Google हेतू आणि मूल्य पाहते, tool नाही. Scaled content abuse मध्ये मुख्यतः rank होण्यासाठी बनवलेली mass pages येतात, ती कशीही बनवलेली असोत. उपयुक्त AI-assisted content ला परवानगी आहे; pages खरे मूल्य देत असतील तर templates ही चालतात.

q.en: An AC repair company in Pune creates 300 pages titled 'Best AC Repair in [City]' for cities across India, with identical text except the city name. It only serves Pune. What's the problem?
q.hi: Pune ki ek AC repair company ne poore India ke cities ke liye 'Best AC Repair in [City]' naam ke 300 pages banaye, sirf city ka naam alag, baaki text same. Company sirf Pune mein service deti hai. Problem kya hai?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका AC repair कंपनीने भारतभरातील शहरांसाठी 'Best AC Repair in [City]' नावाची 300 pages तयार केली, फक्त शहराचे नाव वेगळे, बाकी text सारखा. कंपनी फक्त पुण्यात service देते. समस्या काय आहे?

en: Nothing, because more pages always bring more traffic
They're doorway pages; keep real pages only for areas actually served
The URLs are too short and need the state name added
The pages should be moved to a separate Google Ads account
hi: Kuch nahi, kyunki zyada pages hamesha zyada traffic laate hain
Yeh doorway pages hain; sirf served areas ke real pages rakho
URLs chhote hain, unme state ka naam bhi jodna chahiye
Pages ko alag Google Ads account mein shift karna chahiye
mr: काहीच नाही, कारण जास्त pages नेहमी जास्त traffic आणतात
ही doorway pages आहेत; फक्त service देत असलेल्या भागांची खरी pages ठेवा
URLs लहान आहेत, त्यात राज्याचे नावही जोडायला हवे
pages वेगळ्या Google Ads account मध्ये हलवावीत

exp.en: Near-identical city pages built to catch searches, especially for places you don't serve, are doorway pages. Location pages are fine when they're real and unique: local address, team, projects and service details.
exp.hi: Searches pakadne ke liye bane near-identical city pages, khaaskar un jagahon ke jahan service nahi dete, doorway pages hain. Location pages tab theek hain jab woh real aur unique hon: local address, team, projects aur service details.
exp.mr: Searches पकडण्यासाठी बनवलेली जवळजवळ सारखी city pages, विशेषतः जिथे service देत नाही त्या ठिकाणांसाठी, म्हणजे doorway pages. Location pages खरी आणि unique असतील तर ठीक: local पत्ता, team, projects आणि service तपशील.

q.en: Search Console shows 'Duplicate, Google chose different canonical than user' for your product pages. Your canonical points to /product-a, but Google picked /product-a?ref=home. What should you do?
q.hi: Search Console aapke product pages ke liye 'Duplicate, Google chose different canonical than user' dikha raha hai. Aapka canonical /product-a pe hai, par Google ne /product-a?ref=home chuna. Kya karna chahiye?
q.mr: Search Console तुमच्या product pages साठी 'Duplicate, Google chose different canonical than user' दाखवते. तुमचा canonical /product-a वर आहे, पण Google ने /product-a?ref=home निवडले. काय करावे?

en: Remove the canonical tags from all product pages
Add a noindex tag to /product-a to force a choice
Make internal links, sitemap and redirects all use /product-a
Submit a reconsideration request in Search Console
hi: Saare product pages se canonical tags hata do
Choice force karne ke liye /product-a pe noindex laga do
Internal links, sitemap aur redirects sab mein /product-a use karo
Search Console mein reconsideration request bhejo
mr: सर्व product pages वरून canonical tags काढा
निवड भाग पाडण्यासाठी /product-a वर noindex लावा
internal links, sitemap आणि redirects सर्वांत /product-a वापरा
Search Console मध्ये reconsideration request पाठवा

exp.en: rel=canonical is one signal among several. If internal links (e.g. homepage links with ?ref=home) point to the parameter URL, Google may prefer it. Make all signals consistent. This isn't a manual action, so reconsideration doesn't apply.
exp.hi: rel=canonical kai signals mein se ek hai. Agar internal links (jaise homepage ke ?ref=home wale links) parameter URL ko point karte hain, toh Google use prefer kar sakta hai. Saare signals consistent karo. Yeh manual action nahi hai, isliye reconsideration lagu nahi hota.
exp.mr: rel=canonical हा अनेक signals पैकी एक आहे. Internal links (उदा. homepage वरील ?ref=home links) parameter URL कडे जात असतील तर Google तोच निवडू शकते. सर्व signals एकसारखे करा. हा manual action नाही, त्यामुळे reconsideration लागू होत नाही.

q.en: An Indian e-commerce site's mobile LCP is 5.8 s. The LCP element is a 2 MB hero banner that is lazy-loaded. Which fix helps most?
q.hi: Ek Indian e-commerce site ka mobile LCP 5.8 s hai. LCP element ek 2 MB ka hero banner hai jo lazy-load hota hai. Sabse zyada kaunsa fix help karega?
q.mr: एका Indian e-commerce site चा mobile LCP 5.8 s आहे. LCP element हा 2 MB चा hero banner आहे जो lazy-load होतो. सर्वात जास्त कोणता उपाय मदत करेल?

en: Lazy-load every other image on the page as well, including icons
Add a JavaScript fade-in animation so the banner feels quicker
Turn the banner into an auto-playing carousel of 5 slides
Don't lazy-load the banner; compress it and give it high fetch priority
hi: Page ki baaki saari images, icons samet, lazy-load kar do
JavaScript fade-in animation daalo taaki banner fast lage
Banner ko 5 slides wale auto-play carousel mein badlo
Banner ka lazy-load hatao, compress karo aur high fetch priority do
mr: page वरील इतर सर्व images, icons सह, lazy-load करा
banner जलद वाटावा म्हणून JavaScript fade-in animation टाका
banner ला 5 slides च्या auto-play carousel मध्ये बदला
banner चे lazy-load काढा, compress करा आणि high fetch priority द्या

exp.en: Lazy-loading the LCP image delays it on purpose. Load it eagerly, shrink it and use fetchpriority=high (or preload). Lazy-loading below-the-fold images is fine, but it won't fix this LCP.
exp.hi: LCP image ko lazy-load karna use jaan-boojh ke late karta hai. Use turant load karo, size chhota karo aur fetchpriority=high (ya preload) use karo. Neeche wali images lazy-load karna theek hai, par isse yeh LCP fix nahi hoga.
exp.mr: LCP image lazy-load केल्याने ती मुद्दाम उशिरा येते. ती लगेच load करा, size कमी करा आणि fetchpriority=high (किंवा preload) वापरा. खालच्या images lazy-load करणे ठीक आहे, पण त्याने हा LCP सुधारणार नाही.

q.en: A news site has a poor CLS score because content jumps as ads and images load. What is the main fix?
q.hi: Ek news site ka CLS score kharab hai kyunki ads aur images load hote waqt content jump karta hai. Main fix kya hai?
q.mr: एका news site चा CLS score खराब आहे कारण ads आणि images load होताना content उडी मारतो. मुख्य उपाय कोणता?

en: Set width/height or aspect-ratio for images, ads and embeds
Upgrade the server's RAM and CPU to handle more traffic
Add more internal links inside every news article
Switch the site's images from JPEG to PNG format
hi: Images, ads aur embeds ke liye width/height ya aspect-ratio set karo
Zyada traffic ke liye server ki RAM aur CPU upgrade karo
Har news article ke andar aur internal links daalo
Site ki images JPEG se PNG format mein badlo
mr: images, ads आणि embeds साठी width/height किंवा aspect-ratio set करा
जास्त traffic साठी server ची RAM आणि CPU upgrade करा
प्रत्येक news article मध्ये आणखी internal links टाका
site च्या images JPEG वरून PNG format मध्ये बदला

exp.en: CLS measures unexpected layout shifts. Giving images, ad slots and embeds fixed dimensions reserves space before they load, so the text doesn't jump. Server power mostly affects loading, not layout stability.
exp.hi: CLS unexpected layout shifts measure karta hai. Images, ad slots aur embeds ko fixed dimensions dene se load hone se pehle jagah reserve ho jaati hai, isliye text jump nahi karta. Server power loading ko affect karti hai, layout stability ko nahi.
exp.mr: CLS अनपेक्षित layout shifts मोजतो. Images, ad slots आणि embeds ना निश्चित dimensions दिल्याने load होण्याआधीच जागा राखली जाते, त्यामुळे text उडी मारत नाही. Server ची ताकद loading वर परिणाम करते, layout stability वर नाही.

q.en: An online bookstore has category pages split into ?page=2, ?page=3 and so on. The developer sets the canonical of every paginated page to page 1. What's the better approach per Google's guidance?
q.hi: Ek online bookstore ke category pages ?page=2, ?page=3 waghera mein bante hain. Developer ne har paginated page ka canonical page 1 pe set kar diya. Google guidance ke hisaab se better approach kya hai?
q.mr: एका online bookstore ची category pages ?page=2, ?page=3 अशी विभागलेली आहेत. Developer ने प्रत्येक paginated page चा canonical page 1 वर set केला. Google guidance नुसार अधिक चांगली पद्धत कोणती?

en: Keep the canonical to page 1 and add rel=next/prev, which Google relies on
Give each page its own self-referencing canonical and link pages with normal crawlable links
Noindex and nofollow all pages after page 1
Put all 5,000 books on a single page
hi: Canonical page 1 pe hi rakho aur rel=next/prev lagao, Google usi pe depend karta hai
Har page ka apna self-referencing canonical rakho aur pages ko normal crawlable links se jodo
Page 1 ke baad ke saare pages noindex aur nofollow karo
Saari 5,000 books ek hi page pe daal do
mr: canonical page 1 वरच ठेवा आणि rel=next/prev लावा, Google त्यावरच अवलंबून असते
प्रत्येक page ला स्वतःचा self-referencing canonical द्या आणि pages सामान्य crawlable links ने जोडा
page 1 नंतरची सर्व pages noindex आणि nofollow करा
सर्व 5,000 पुस्तके एकाच page वर टाका

exp.en: Pointing every page's canonical to page 1 can hide products on deeper pages. Google advises self-canonical paginated URLs linked with regular <a href> links. Google said in 2019 it no longer uses rel=next/prev as an indexing signal.
exp.hi: Har page ka canonical page 1 pe karne se deeper pages ke products chhup sakte hain. Google self-canonical paginated URLs recommend karta hai jo normal <a href> links se jude hon. Google ne 2019 mein kaha tha ki woh rel=next/prev ko indexing signal ki tarah use nahi karta.
exp.mr: प्रत्येक page चा canonical page 1 वर केल्यास पुढील pages वरील products लपू शकतात. Google self-canonical paginated URLs सुचवते जे साध्या <a href> links ने जोडलेले असतात. Google ने 2019 मध्ये सांगितले की ते rel=next/prev indexing signal म्हणून वापरत नाही.

q.en: An Indian D2C brand on brand.in is expanding to the UAE and US with English sites, different prices and currencies. Small team, strong domain authority. Which setup is the most sensible start?
q.hi: brand.in wala ek Indian D2C brand UAE aur US mein English sites ke saath expand ho raha hai, alag prices aur currencies ke saath. Team chhoti hai, domain authority strong hai. Sabse sensible start kya hai?
q.mr: brand.in वरील एक Indian D2C brand UAE आणि US मध्ये English sites सह विस्तार करत आहे, वेगळ्या किमती आणि चलनांसह. Team लहान आहे, domain authority मजबूत आहे. सर्वात योग्य सुरुवात कोणती?

en: One page for all countries that auto-switches currency by IP, with no separate URLs
Copy the whole site to three new unrelated domains with no hreflang
Subfolders on one generic domain (e.g. /en-ae/, /en-us/) with hreflang and localized prices
Only change the currency symbol with JavaScript on the same URLs
hi: Sab countries ke liye ek page jo IP se currency auto-switch kare, alag URLs nahi
Poori site ko teen naye unrelated domains pe copy karo bina hreflang ke
Ek generic domain pe subfolders (jaise /en-ae/, /en-us/) hreflang aur localized prices ke saath
Same URLs pe sirf JavaScript se currency symbol badlo
mr: सर्व देशांसाठी एकच page जे IP नुसार चलन आपोआप बदलते, वेगळे URLs नाहीत
संपूर्ण site तीन नवीन असंबंधित domains वर hreflang शिवाय copy करा
एका generic domain वर subfolders (उदा. /en-ae/, /en-us/) hreflang आणि localized किमतींसह
त्याच URLs वर फक्त JavaScript ने चलन चिन्ह बदला

exp.en: Subfolders keep authority on one domain and are cheaper to run than separate ccTLDs, while hreflang maps each market. A .in ccTLD signals India, so a generic domain (like .com) is usually better for subfolders. Each version needs its own crawlable URL.
exp.hi: Subfolders authority ek domain pe rakhte hain aur alag ccTLDs se sasta padte hain, aur hreflang har market ko map karta hai. .in ccTLD India ka signal deta hai, isliye subfolders ke liye generic domain (jaise .com) aam taur pe better hai. Har version ka apna crawlable URL chahiye.
exp.mr: Subfolders मुळे authority एका domain वर राहते आणि वेगळ्या ccTLDs पेक्षा खर्च कमी येतो, तर hreflang प्रत्येक market जोडतो. .in ccTLD भारताचा signal देतो, म्हणून subfolders साठी generic domain (उदा. .com) सहसा चांगला. प्रत्येक version ला स्वतःचा crawlable URL हवा.

q.en: What can server log file analysis show that Search Console reports don't show in full detail?
q.hi: Server log file analysis kya dikha sakta hai jo Search Console reports poori detail mein nahi dikhate?
q.mr: Server log file analysis काय दाखवू शकते जे Search Console reports पूर्ण तपशीलात दाखवत नाहीत?

en: The complete list of backlinks pointing to competitors' sites
Your exact daily keyword ranking positions on Google Search
Each visitor's name, email address and phone number
Which URLs Googlebot requested, how often, and status codes
hi: Competitors ki sites pe aane wale backlinks ki poori list
Google Search pe aapki exact daily keyword ranking positions
Har visitor ka naam, email address aur phone number
Googlebot ne kaunse URLs, kitni baar request kiye aur kya status codes mile
mr: competitors च्या sites कडे येणाऱ्या backlinks ची संपूर्ण यादी
Google Search वरील तुमच्या exact daily keyword ranking positions
प्रत्येक visitor चे नाव, email address आणि phone number
Googlebot ने कोणते URLs, किती वेळा request केले आणि कोणते status codes मिळाले

exp.en: Logs record every bot request, so you can see crawl waste on parameters, orphan pages, redirect chains and errors. Verify Googlebot by reverse DNS, since user agents can be faked. Logs don't show rankings or competitor links.
exp.hi: Logs har bot request record karte hain, isliye parameters pe crawl waste, orphan pages, redirect chains aur errors dikhte hain. Googlebot ko reverse DNS se verify karo, kyunki user agent fake ho sakta hai. Logs rankings ya competitor links nahi dikhate.
exp.mr: Logs प्रत्येक bot request नोंदवतात, त्यामुळे parameters वरील crawl waste, orphan pages, redirect chains आणि errors दिसतात. User agent खोटा असू शकतो म्हणून Googlebot reverse DNS ने verify करा. Logs rankings किंवा competitor links दाखवत नाहीत.

q.en: A news site auto-translates every English article into Marathi with a machine tool and publishes without review. The Marathi pages get little traffic and some read awkwardly. Best plan?
q.hi: Ek news site har English article ko machine tool se Marathi mein auto-translate karke bina review ke publish karti hai. Marathi pages pe traffic kam hai aur kuch ajeeb padhte hain. Best plan?
q.mr: एक news site प्रत्येक English article machine tool ने मराठीत auto-translate करून review न करता प्रकाशित करते. मराठी pages ला traffic कमी आहे आणि काही वाचायला विचित्र वाटतात. सर्वोत्तम योजना?

en: Human-review key translations; separate URLs per language with hreflang
Serve Marathi or English on the same URL based on a cookie
Canonicalize every Marathi page to its English original
Machine-translate even more articles to increase volume
hi: Important translations human review karo; har language ka alag URL + hreflang
Cookie ke basis pe same URL pe Marathi ya English dikhao
Har Marathi page ka canonical uske English original pe karo
Volume badhane ke liye aur zyada articles machine-translate karo
mr: महत्त्वाची भाषांतरे माणसांकडून review करा; प्रत्येक भाषेसाठी वेगळा URL + hreflang
cookie नुसार त्याच URL वर मराठी किंवा English दाखवा
प्रत्येक मराठी page चा canonical त्याच्या English original वर करा
volume वाढवण्यासाठी आणखी articles machine-translate करा

exp.en: Unreviewed machine translation at scale can be low-value or even count as scaled content. Human-reviewed versions on separate URLs with hreflang serve Marathi readers properly. Canonicalizing to English would drop the Marathi pages from results.
exp.hi: Bina review ka bulk machine translation low-value ho sakta hai, ya scaled content bhi maana ja sakta hai. Alag URLs pe human-reviewed versions hreflang ke saath Marathi readers ko sahi serve karte hain. English pe canonical karne se Marathi pages results se hat jaayenge.
exp.mr: Review न केलेले मोठ्या प्रमाणातील machine translation कमी मूल्याचे ठरू शकते, किंवा scaled content ही मानले जाऊ शकते. वेगळ्या URLs वरील human-reviewed versions hreflang सह मराठी वाचकांना योग्य सेवा देतात. English वर canonical केल्यास मराठी pages results मधून जातील.

q.en: A brand has /en-in/ and /en-us/ versions with near-identical content and correct hreflang. But the /en-us/ page's canonical points to /en-in/. US users keep landing on the Indian page. Why?
q.hi: Ek brand ke /en-in/ aur /en-us/ versions hain, content lagbhag same hai aur hreflang sahi hai. Par /en-us/ page ka canonical /en-in/ pe point karta hai. US users Indian page pe hi pahunch rahe hain. Kyun?
q.mr: एका brand चे /en-in/ आणि /en-us/ versions आहेत, content जवळजवळ सारखा आणि hreflang योग्य आहे. पण /en-us/ page चा canonical /en-in/ कडे निर्देश करतो. US users भारतीय page वरच येत आहेत. का?

en: hreflang only works between languages, never between regions
The cross-canonical marks /en-us/ as a duplicate; use self-canonicals
US users must add a country code to their search queries
The /en-us/ page needs its own XML sitemap to override it
hi: hreflang sirf languages ke beech kaam karta hai, regions ke beech kabhi nahi
Cross-canonical /en-us/ ko duplicate bana deta hai; self-canonical use karo
US users ko apni search queries mein country code daalna hoga
Override ke liye /en-us/ page ka apna XML sitemap chahiye
mr: hreflang फक्त भाषांमध्ये काम करतो, regions मध्ये कधीच नाही
cross-canonical मुळे /en-us/ duplicate ठरते; self-canonical वापरा
US users ना आपल्या search queries मध्ये country code टाकावा लागेल
override करण्यासाठी /en-us/ page चा स्वतःचा XML sitemap हवा

exp.en: hreflang only swaps between indexable canonical URLs. Canonicalizing /en-us/ to /en-in/ removes it from the index, so there's nothing to swap in. Use self-referencing canonicals on every language or region version.
exp.hi: hreflang sirf indexable canonical URLs ke beech swap karta hai. /en-us/ ka canonical /en-in/ pe karne se woh index se hat jaata hai, toh swap karne ke liye kuch bachta hi nahi. Har language ya region version pe self-referencing canonical rakho.
exp.mr: hreflang फक्त indexable canonical URLs मध्ये बदल करतो. /en-us/ चा canonical /en-in/ वर केल्याने ते index मधून जाते, त्यामुळे बदलण्यासाठी काहीच उरत नाही. प्रत्येक भाषा किंवा region version वर self-referencing canonical ठेवा.

q.en: A furniture store's category page loads products only through infinite scroll. There are no paginated URLs, and only the first 24 of 600 products get indexed. What's the fix?
q.hi: Ek furniture store ke category page pe products sirf infinite scroll se load hote hain. Koi paginated URLs nahi hain, aur 600 mein se sirf pehle 24 products index hote hain. Fix kya hai?
q.mr: एका furniture store च्या category page वर products फक्त infinite scroll ने load होतात. Paginated URLs नाहीत, आणि 600 पैकी फक्त पहिले 24 products index होतात. उपाय काय?

en: Ask Google Support to crawl the page by scrolling it manually
Load 100 products per scroll instead of 24 so more are seen
Add paginated URLs with crawlable links, keeping infinite scroll for users
List all 600 product names inside the meta keywords tag
hi: Google Support se kaho ki page ko manually scroll karke crawl kare
24 ki jagah har scroll pe 100 products load karo taaki zyada dikhein
Crawlable links wale paginated URLs bhi do, users ke liye infinite scroll rakho
Saare 600 product names meta keywords tag ke andar daal do
mr: Google Support ला page manually scroll करून crawl करायला सांगा
जास्त दिसावेत म्हणून 24 ऐवजी प्रत्येक scroll वर 100 products load करा
crawlable links सह paginated URLs ही द्या, users साठी infinite scroll ठेवा
सर्व 600 product names meta keywords tag मध्ये टाका

exp.en: Googlebot generally doesn't scroll or click to trigger loading, so products loaded only on scroll may never be found. Paginated URLs linked with <a href> make every product reachable. Google ignores the meta keywords tag.
exp.hi: Googlebot aam taur pe loading trigger karne ke liye scroll ya click nahi karta, isliye sirf scroll pe load hone wale products mil hi nahi paate. <a href> se jude paginated URLs har product tak pahunch dete hain. Google meta keywords tag ignore karta hai.
exp.mr: Googlebot सहसा loading सुरू करण्यासाठी scroll किंवा click करत नाही, त्यामुळे फक्त scroll वर load होणारे products सापडतच नाहीत. <a href> ने जोडलेले paginated URLs प्रत्येक product पर्यंत पोहोचवतात. Google meta keywords tag दुर्लक्षित करते.

q.en: A large classifieds site with 1 million URLs sees Googlebot's crawl requests drop sharply. Crawl Stats show rising 5xx errors and slow response times. What's the most likely explanation?
q.hi: 1 million URLs wali ek badi classifieds site pe Googlebot ki crawl requests achanak bahut gir gayi. Crawl Stats mein 5xx errors aur slow response time badh rahe hain. Sabse likely explanation kya hai?
q.mr: 1 million URLs असलेल्या एका मोठ्या classifieds site वर Googlebot च्या crawl requests अचानक खूप कमी झाल्या. Crawl Stats मध्ये 5xx errors आणि मंद response time वाढत आहेत. सर्वात संभाव्य स्पष्टीकरण कोणते?

en: Google has applied a manual action to the site for thin content
The XML sitemap lists too many URLs for Google to read
Competitors are pointing spam links at the site to hurt it
Google slows crawling when a server is slow or erroring; fix the server
hi: Google ne thin content ke liye site pe manual action lagaya hai
XML sitemap mein Google ke padhne ke liye bahut zyada URLs hain
Competitors nuksaan pahunchane ke liye site pe spam links bhej rahe hain
Server slow ho ya errors de toh Google crawling ghatata hai; server theek karo
mr: Google ने thin content साठी site वर manual action लावला आहे
XML sitemap मध्ये Google ला वाचण्यासाठी खूप जास्त URLs आहेत
नुकसान करण्यासाठी competitors site कडे spam links पाठवत आहेत
server मंद असेल किंवा errors देत असेल तर Google crawling कमी करते; server दुरुस्त करा

exp.en: Google's crawl capacity limit adapts to server health: slow responses and 5xx errors make Googlebot back off to avoid overloading the site. Once the server is stable and fast, crawling recovers. Manual actions appear in their own report.
exp.hi: Google ki crawl capacity limit server health ke hisaab se badalti hai: slow responses aur 5xx errors pe Googlebot peeche hat jaata hai taaki site overload na ho. Server stable aur fast hote hi crawling wapas badhti hai. Manual actions ki alag report hoti hai.
exp.mr: Google ची crawl capacity limit server च्या आरोग्यानुसार बदलते: मंद responses आणि 5xx errors आल्यावर site overload होऊ नये म्हणून Googlebot मागे हटतो. Server स्थिर आणि जलद झाल्यावर crawling पुन्हा वाढते. Manual actions चा वेगळा report असतो.

q.en: A new Pune interior design firm has a fresh website, zero rankings and ₹30,000/month for SEO. 'Interior designer Pune' is dominated by big players. Which plan gives the best early results?
q.hi: Pune ki ek nayi interior design firm ki fresh website hai, zero rankings aur SEO ke liye ₹30,000/month. 'Interior designer Pune' pe bade players chhaaye hue hain. Kaunsa plan sabse achhe early results dega?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका नवीन interior design firm ची नवी website आहे, rankings शून्य आणि SEO साठी ₹30,000/महिना. 'Interior designer Pune' वर मोठ्या players चे वर्चस्व आहे. कोणती योजना सुरुवातीला सर्वोत्तम परिणाम देईल?

en: Local first: GBP and reviews, project pages, long-tail like '2BHK interior cost Pune'
Spend the full budget on buying links for 'interior designer Pune'
Publish 100 short AI posts on general home décor in month one
Wait until the domain is a year old before starting any SEO
hi: Local pehle: GBP aur reviews, project pages, '2BHK interior cost Pune' jaisi long-tail
Poora budget 'interior designer Pune' ke links khareedne pe lagao
Pehle mahine general home décor pe 100 chhote AI posts daalo
Koi bhi SEO shuru karne se pehle domain ke ek saal ka hone ka wait karo
mr: आधी local: GBP आणि reviews, project pages, '2BHK interior cost Pune' सारख्या long-tail
संपूर्ण budget 'interior designer Pune' च्या links विकत घेण्यावर खर्च करा
पहिल्या महिन्यात सामान्य home décor वर 100 छोटे AI posts टाका
कोणतेही SEO सुरू करण्याआधी domain एक वर्ष जुना होण्याची वाट पाहा

exp.en: New sites win faster in the local pack and on specific, high-intent long-tail queries. Real project pages show experience and convert well. Chasing one head term with bought links is risky; mass generic posts rarely help.
exp.hi: Nayi sites local pack aur specific, high-intent long-tail queries pe jaldi jeet-ti hain. Real project pages experience dikhate hain aur achha convert karte hain. Ek head term ke peeche khareede links se bhaagna risky hai; bulk generic posts se shayad hi fayda ho.
exp.mr: नवीन sites local pack आणि specific, high-intent long-tail queries वर लवकर यश मिळवतात. खरी project pages अनुभव दाखवतात आणि चांगले convert करतात. एका head term मागे विकत घेतलेल्या links घेऊन धावणे धोकादायक आहे; मोठ्या प्रमाणात generic posts क्वचितच मदत करतात.

q.en: A finance blog's impressions are stable but clicks on 'what is SIP'-type queries have fallen sharply since AI Overviews began appearing for them. What's the smartest strategy?
q.hi: Ek finance blog ke impressions stable hain par 'what is SIP' jaisi queries pe clicks tezi se gire hain, jab se unpe AI Overviews dikhne lage. Sabse smart strategy kya hai?
q.mr: एका finance blog चे impressions स्थिर आहेत पण 'what is SIP' सारख्या queries वरील clicks, त्यांच्यावर AI Overviews दिसू लागल्यापासून, झपाट्याने घसरले आहेत. सर्वात हुशार रणनीती कोणती?

en: Block Googlebot in robots.txt so Google can't summarize your content
Add unique value (data, calculators, expert views) and track leads, not just clicks
Publish ten times more short definition posts to win back clicks
Add the phrase 'AI Overview' as a keyword in every page title
hi: robots.txt mein Googlebot block karo taaki Google content summarize na kare
Unique value do (data, calculators, expert views) aur sirf clicks nahi, leads track karo
Clicks wapas laane ke liye das guna zyada chhote definition posts daalo
Har page title mein 'AI Overview' phrase keyword ki tarah daalo
mr: Google content summarize करू नये म्हणून robots.txt मध्ये Googlebot block करा
unique मूल्य द्या (data, calculators, expert views) आणि फक्त clicks नव्हे, leads track करा
clicks परत मिळवण्यासाठी दहापट जास्त छोटे definition posts टाका
प्रत्येक page title मध्ये 'AI Overview' phrase keyword म्हणून टाका

exp.en: Simple definitions are easily answered on the results page. Content with original data, tools and expertise earns citations and clicks for deeper needs. Blocking Googlebot would remove you from Search entirely.
exp.hi: Simple definitions ka jawab results page pe hi mil jaata hai. Original data, tools aur expertise wala content deeper needs ke liye citations aur clicks kamata hai. Googlebot block karne se aap Search se hi poori tarah gayab ho jaoge.
exp.mr: साध्या व्याख्यांचे उत्तर results page वरच मिळते. Original data, tools आणि expertise असलेला content सखोल गरजांसाठी citations आणि clicks मिळवतो. Googlebot block केल्यास तुम्ही Search मधूनच पूर्णपणे गायब व्हाल.

q.en: A publisher adds 'User-agent: Google-Extended' with 'Disallow: /' to robots.txt. What effect does this have on Google Search, including AI Overviews?
q.hi: Ek publisher robots.txt mein 'User-agent: Google-Extended' ke saath 'Disallow: /' daalta hai. Iska Google Search, AI Overviews samet, pe kya asar hoga?
q.mr: एक publisher robots.txt मध्ये 'User-agent: Google-Extended' सह 'Disallow: /' टाकतो. याचा Google Search वर, AI Overviews सह, काय परिणाम होईल?

en: The whole site is removed from Google Search results completely
The site stays in Search but is removed from AI Overviews only
No Search effect; it limits Gemini use. nosnippet etc. govern AI Overviews
Googlebot stops crawling every page of the site for Search
hi: Poori site Google Search results se completely hat jaati hai
Site Search mein rehti hai par sirf AI Overviews se hat jaati hai
Search pe asar nahi; Gemini use limit hota hai. AI Overviews pe nosnippet jaise controls
Googlebot Search ke liye site ka har page crawl karna band kar deta hai
mr: संपूर्ण site Google Search results मधून पूर्णपणे काढली जाते
site Search मध्ये राहते पण फक्त AI Overviews मधून काढली जाते
Search वर परिणाम नाही; Gemini वापर मर्यादित होतो. AI Overviews साठी nosnippet सारखे controls
Googlebot Search साठी site चे प्रत्येक page crawl करणे थांबवतो

exp.en: Google-Extended is a control token for use in Gemini models; Google states it doesn't affect inclusion or ranking in Search. AI Overviews are part of Search, so they follow Search controls such as nosnippet, max-snippet or noindex.
exp.hi: Google-Extended Gemini models mein use ke liye control token hai; Google kehta hai ki isse Search mein inclusion ya ranking pe asar nahi padta. AI Overviews Search ka hissa hain, isliye woh nosnippet, max-snippet ya noindex jaise Search controls follow karte hain.
exp.mr: Google-Extended हा Gemini models मधील वापरासाठी control token आहे; Google सांगते की याचा Search मधील समावेश किंवा ranking वर परिणाम होत नाही. AI Overviews हे Search चा भाग आहेत, त्यामुळे ते nosnippet, max-snippet किंवा noindex सारखे Search controls पाळतात.

q.en: A Pune startup is rebranding from oldname.in to newname.com. The old domain has strong links and rankings. Which migration plan is safest?
q.hi: Pune ka ek startup oldname.in se newname.com pe rebrand kar raha hai. Purane domain ke strong links aur rankings hain. Sabse safe migration plan kaunsa hai?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एक startup oldname.in वरून newname.com वर rebrand करत आहे. जुन्या domain च्या मजबूत links आणि rankings आहेत. सर्वात सुरक्षित migration योजना कोणती?

en: Redirect all old URLs to the new homepage; let old domain lapse in a month
Launch the new domain with copied content and keep the old site live too
Use 302 redirects everywhere in case the rebrand is ever reversed
1:1 301 redirects, Change of Address tool, keep redirects at least a year
hi: Saare purane URLs naye homepage pe redirect karo; ek mahine mein purana domain chhod do
Naya domain copied content ke saath launch karo aur purani site bhi live rakho
Rebrand kabhi wapas lena pade isliye har jagah 302 redirects lagao
1:1 301 redirects, Change of Address tool, aur redirects kam se kam ek saal
mr: सर्व जुने URLs नवीन homepage कडे redirect करा; महिनाभरात जुना domain सोडा
copied content सह नवीन domain launch करा आणि जुनी site ही live ठेवा
rebrand कधी मागे घ्यावे लागले तर म्हणून सगळीकडे 302 redirects लावा
1:1 301 redirects, Change of Address tool, आणि redirects किमान एक वर्ष

exp.en: Page-level 301s transfer signals to matching pages; redirecting everything to the homepage is often treated as soft 404. Google advises keeping redirects for at least a year, and letting the old domain lapse risks losing links or someone else buying it.
exp.hi: Page-level 301s signals ko matching pages tak pahunchate hain; sab kuch homepage pe redirect karna aksar soft 404 maana jaata hai. Google kam se kam ek saal redirects rakhne ki salah deta hai, aur purana domain expire karne se links khone ya kisi aur ke khareed lene ka risk hai.
exp.mr: Page-level 301s signals जुळणाऱ्या pages कडे पोहोचवतात; सगळे homepage कडे redirect करणे बहुधा soft 404 मानले जाते. Google किमान एक वर्ष redirects ठेवण्याचा सल्ला देते, आणि जुना domain expire होऊ दिल्यास links गमावण्याचा किंवा दुसऱ्याने तो विकत घेण्याचा धोका असतो.

q.en: A multi-speciality clinic's health articles lost traffic after a core update. There's no manual action. Articles are written by anonymous content writers, with no medical review or sources. Best recovery approach?
q.hi: Ek multi-speciality clinic ke health articles ka traffic core update ke baad gir gaya. Koi manual action nahi hai. Articles anonymous content writers ne likhe hain, na medical review, na sources. Best recovery approach?
q.mr: एका multi-speciality clinic च्या health articles चे traffic core update नंतर घसरले. Manual action नाही. Articles अनामिक content writers नी लिहिले आहेत, medical review किंवा sources नाहीत. सर्वोत्तम recovery पद्धत कोणती?

en: Have doctors write or review, add credentials, cite sources, update advice
Submit a reconsideration request to Google through Search Console
Change every article's publish date to today to look fresh
Add more keywords like 'best doctor near me' to every article
hi: Doctors se likhwao ya review karwao, credentials daalo, sources cite karo, advice update karo
Search Console se Google ko reconsideration request bhejo
Fresh dikhne ke liye har article ki publish date aaj ki kar do
Har article mein 'best doctor near me' jaise aur keywords daalo
mr: doctors कडून लिहून/review करून घ्या, credentials टाका, sources द्या, सल्ला update करा
Search Console मधून Google ला reconsideration request पाठवा
ताजे दिसावे म्हणून प्रत्येक article ची publish date आजची करा
प्रत्येक article मध्ये 'best doctor near me' सारखे आणखी keywords टाका

exp.en: Health content is 'Your Money or Your Life' (YMYL), where Google weighs E-E-A-T heavily. Real expert authorship, review and sourcing improve quality. Reconsideration requests are only for manual actions, and fake date changes don't add value.
exp.hi: Health content 'Your Money or Your Life' (YMYL) hai, jahan Google E-E-A-T ko bahut weight deta hai. Real expert authorship, review aur sourcing se quality badhti hai. Reconsideration request sirf manual actions ke liye hota hai, aur fake date badalne se value nahi badhti.
exp.mr: Health content हा 'Your Money or Your Life' (YMYL) आहे, जिथे Google E-E-A-T ला जास्त महत्त्व देते. खरे expert लेखक, review आणि sources मुळे quality वाढते. Reconsideration request फक्त manual actions साठी असते, आणि खोट्या तारखा बदलल्याने मूल्य वाढत नाही.

q.en: A dental clinic adds LocalBusiness schema with AggregateRating on its own homepage, using its Google reviews, hoping to get star ratings in organic results. What will most likely happen?
q.hi: Ek dental clinic apne hi homepage pe LocalBusiness schema ke saath AggregateRating daalta hai, apne Google reviews use karke, taaki organic results mein star ratings dikhein. Sabse likely kya hoga?
q.mr: एक dental clinic आपल्याच homepage वर LocalBusiness schema सह AggregateRating टाकतो, आपले Google reviews वापरून, जेणेकरून organic results मध्ये star ratings दिसतील. बहुधा काय होईल?

en: Star ratings will appear in organic results within 24 hours
No stars; self-serving LocalBusiness reviews aren't eligible for snippets
The clinic will jump to the first position in the local pack
Google will copy the star rating into the Business Profile
hi: 24 ghante mein organic results mein star ratings dikhne lagengi
Stars nahi; self-serving LocalBusiness reviews snippets ke liye eligible nahi
Clinic local pack mein seedha pehli position pe aa jaayega
Google star rating ko Business Profile mein copy kar dega
mr: 24 तासांत organic results मध्ये star ratings दिसू लागतील
Stars नाहीत; self-serving LocalBusiness reviews snippets साठी पात्र नाहीत
clinic local pack मध्ये थेट पहिल्या स्थानावर येईल
Google star rating Business Profile मध्ये copy करेल

exp.en: Since 2019 Google has not shown review rich results when a LocalBusiness or Organization marks up reviews about itself on its own site. Also, marking up reviews copied from other platforms goes against review snippet guidelines.
exp.hi: 2019 se Google tab review rich results nahi dikhata jab LocalBusiness ya Organization apni hi site pe apne baare mein reviews markup kare. Saath hi, doosre platforms se copy kiye reviews ko markup karna review snippet guidelines ke khilaf hai.
exp.mr: 2019 पासून LocalBusiness किंवा Organization ने आपल्याच site वर स्वतःबद्दलचे reviews markup केल्यास Google review rich results दाखवत नाही. तसेच, इतर platforms वरून copy केलेले reviews markup करणे review snippet guidelines विरुद्ध आहे.

q.en: A property portal with 2 lakh listing URLs shows most new listings as 'Discovered – currently not indexed' for weeks. Many listings are near-duplicates and expired ones return 200. Server is fast. Best plan?
q.hi: 2 lakh listing URLs wale ek property portal pe zyada tar nayi listings hafton se 'Discovered – currently not indexed' dikha rahi hain. Kai listings near-duplicate hain aur expired listings 200 return karti hain. Server fast hai. Best plan?
q.mr: 2 लाख listing URLs असलेल्या एका property portal वर बहुतेक नवीन listings आठवडोंन आठवडे 'Discovered – currently not indexed' दाखवतात. अनेक listings near-duplicate आहेत आणि expired listings 200 देतात. Server जलद आहे. सर्वोत्तम योजना?

en: Request indexing for all 2 lakh URLs one by one in URL Inspection
Add noindex to every new listing until it is one month old
Prune low-value URLs (410 expired, merge duplicates), boost internal links
Buy a bigger server even though responses are already fast
hi: URL Inspection mein saare 2 lakh URLs ki ek-ek karke indexing request karo
Har nayi listing pe ek mahine tak noindex lagao
Low-value URLs hatao (expired pe 410, duplicates merge), internal links badhao
Server already fast hai phir bhi bada server khareedo
mr: URL Inspection मध्ये सर्व 2 लाख URLs साठी एकेक करून indexing request करा
प्रत्येक नवीन listing वर एक महिना noindex लावा
कमी-मूल्याचे URLs काढा (expired वर 410, duplicates merge), internal links वाढवा
responses आधीच जलद असूनही मोठा server विकत घ्या

exp.en: 'Discovered' means Google knows the URL but hasn't crawled it yet. With a healthy server, the issue is usually crawl demand: too many low-value URLs dilute it. Pruning, proper status codes and strong internal links focus Googlebot on URLs that matter. URL Inspection has daily limits.
exp.hi: 'Discovered' matlab Google URL jaanta hai par abhi crawl nahi kiya. Server healthy ho toh issue aam taur pe crawl demand hota hai: bahut saare low-value URLs use dilute kar dete hain. Pruning, sahi status codes aur strong internal links Googlebot ko important URLs pe focus karate hain. URL Inspection ki daily limits hoti hain.
exp.mr: 'Discovered' म्हणजे Google ला URL माहीत आहे पण अजून crawl केले नाही. Server निरोगी असल्यास समस्या बहुधा crawl demand ची असते: अनेक कमी-मूल्याचे URLs ती विभागतात. Pruning, योग्य status codes आणि मजबूत internal links मुळे Googlebot महत्त्वाच्या URLs वर लक्ष देतो. URL Inspection ला दैनिक मर्यादा असतात.

q.en: A travel site auto-redirects visitors by IP: Indian IPs go to /in/, US IPs to /us/. Google rarely indexes the /in/ pages. Why, and what's the best fix?
q.hi: Ek travel site visitors ko IP ke hisaab se auto-redirect karti hai: Indian IPs /in/ pe, US IPs /us/ pe. Google /in/ pages ko kam hi index karta hai. Kyun, aur best fix kya hai?
q.mr: एक travel site visitors ना IP नुसार auto-redirect करते: Indian IPs /in/ वर, US IPs /us/ वर. Google /in/ pages क्वचितच index करते. का, आणि सर्वोत्तम उपाय काय?

en: Google doesn't index country subfolders, so move /in/ to a subdomain
The /in/ URLs need more keywords added to rank and get indexed
Indian pages load slower, so Googlebot skips crawling them
Googlebot crawls mostly from US IPs; drop forced redirects, use hreflang
hi: Google country subfolders index nahi karta, isliye /in/ ko subdomain pe le jao
/in/ URLs mein index hone ke liye aur keywords chahiye
Indian pages slow load hote hain, isliye Googlebot unhe skip karta hai
Googlebot zyada tar US IPs se crawl karta hai; forced redirects hatao, hreflang lagao
mr: Google country subfolders index करत नाही, म्हणून /in/ subdomain वर न्या
/in/ URLs index होण्यासाठी त्यात आणखी keywords हवेत
Indian pages हळू load होतात, म्हणून Googlebot ती वगळतो
Googlebot बहुतेक US IPs वरून crawl करतो; सक्तीचे redirects काढा, hreflang लावा

exp.en: Googlebot's crawling mostly originates from US IPs, so IP-based forced redirects can hide other versions from it. Let every version be reachable by its own URL, connect them with hreflang, and suggest (not force) the local version to users.
exp.hi: Googlebot ki crawling zyada tar US IPs se hoti hai, isliye IP-based forced redirects doosre versions ko usse chhupa dete hain. Har version apne URL se reachable ho, unhe hreflang se jodo, aur users ko local version suggest karo, force nahi.
exp.mr: Googlebot चे crawling बहुतेक US IPs वरून होते, त्यामुळे IP-based सक्तीचे redirects इतर versions त्याच्यापासून लपवू शकतात. प्रत्येक version त्याच्या स्वतःच्या URL वरून उपलब्ध ठेवा, hreflang ने जोडा, आणि users ना local version सुचवा, सक्ती करू नका.
